api/Frontend.Runtime.Impl.GameImpl.Battl.title: Class RtsNetGameMode | Panzer War Document
api/Frontend.Runtime.Impl.GameImpl.Battl.summary: Class RtsNetGameMode Online RTS (BattleUnitOwnership.md §25, server docs/rts.md): every player picks a lineup within the budget per wave and deploys it whole; the server lays it out at one of their side's spawn points. Once all of a player's units are gone they wait out the cooldown and deploy again. Units are ordered from the map (the offline commander's RtsCommandController) or driven one at a time. The server owns the clock, the prices, the scores and the outcome. A unit's last order rides its sync state, so whoever simulates it next (the host for a player who left, the owner after a rejoin) carries it on. api/Frontend.Runtime.Impl.GameImpl.Battl.summary: Class WarZoneNetGameMode War zone network game mode: the capture zone map, except a sortie is bought rather than granted. Every price is the server's; this only shows the table it resolved. A room may let a player keep several vehicles (BattleUnitOwnership.md §16.3 A7): while alive they buy more at the usual price, each holding at its spawn point until driven. eventReference 是私有 [SerializeField] 的 EventReference 结构，不是可拖放的 ScriptableObject。请在检视面板的事件选择器中挑选真实事件，例如 event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "list", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.EventManager/Events", "fields": "Path,Guid/Data1,Guid/Data2,Guid/Data3,Guid/Data4", "search": "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit", "count": 5 }, "expect": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)" }, "capture": { "Data1": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 1, "as": "int" }, "Data2": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 2, "as": "int" }, "Data3": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 3, "as": "int" }, "Data4": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 4, "as": "int" } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.EventManager/EventFromPath", "args": [ "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "parameter:/engine01_cockpit/zoom" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "eventReference": { "Path": "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit", "Guid": { "Data1": "${Data1}", "Data2": "${Data2}", "Data3": "${Data3}", "Data4": "${Data4}" } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. 参数数组 展开 playParams 并添加一个元素，填写 key = zoom、value = 0.5。PlayParm 的两个字段分别为 string 和 float，组件在播放前逐个调用 setParameterByName。本配方会先查询当前事件缓存，确认示例事件存在并定义了 zoom；换用其他事件时，应填写该事件实际拥有的参数名。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "playParams": [ { "key": "zoom", "value": 0.5 } ] } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent)/playParams/0/key" }, "expect": { "contains": "zoom" } } ] 4. 生命周期与距离 勾选 isCustomSoundMaxDistance，显示 customSoundMaxDistance 后填入 75；关闭覆盖时该字段隐藏。默认覆盖关闭、距离为 50。这里限制的是启用时是否开始播放，不是持续更新的声音衰减范围。 OnEnable 调用 Play。若此时相机距离超过上限，方法直接返回，靠近后不会自动重播；事件为空、音效池未准备好或音效包加载失败时也不会开始播放。禁用或销毁会取消尚未完成的等待：isStopEventOnDisable = true 时归还已有实例到池；设为 false 时走 ReleaseEvent 路径，不能据此保证声音立即停止。本例保持 true。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "isStopEventOnDisable": true, "isCustomSoundMaxDistance": true, "customSoundMaxDistance": 75 } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent)/customSoundMaxDistance" }, "expect": { "contains": "75" } } ] 配方验证了 prefab、事件引用和参数读回；实际音频输出、音效包加载和游戏内距离行为仍需运行时验证。

"asset:${vehicleData}/vehicleTextData", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/AssetName" }, "expect": { "contains": "TutorialTank" } }, { "tool": 血量（PSParameter.Health，图中标记 1）。代码默认值为 1200，本例教学值也填 1200。 在 视野 分组中找到 观察范围（PSParameter.viewRange，图中标记 2）。允许范围是 220–5000，代码默认值为 220，本例教学值填 600。 保存资产，再重新选中该资产，确认 PSParameter.Health 与 PSParameter.viewRange 已写入目标资产，而不是其他资产。 PSParameter.Health=1200 和 PSParameter.viewRange=600 只是教学取值，不是官方平衡建议。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 路径使用真实代码字段名，不受编辑器语言影响。资产字段写入会保存；随后重新选择并读回断言。 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health", "value": "1200" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/viewRange", "value": "600" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/SaveAssets", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health" }, "expect": { "contains": "1200" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/viewRange" }, "expect": { "contains": "600" } } ] 3. 高级参数 点击对应的 移动、开火、炮塔 或 多炮塔 标签页，再按下表寻找字段；杂项 位于标签页下方。 字段 Inspector 分组与含义 显示条件与读取行为 sharedGunData 共享主炮数据（开火） 始终显示；非空时 GetTankFireParam() 返回其中的 tankFireParameter。 TFParameter 主炮参数（开火） 仅当没有 sharedGunData 时显示；此时 GetTankFireParam() 返回它。 sharedTurretData 共享炮塔数据（炮塔） 始终显示；非空时 GetTurretParam() 返回其中的 turretParameter。 MTParameter 炮塔参数（炮塔） 仅当没有 sharedTurretData 时显示；此时 GetTurretParam() 返回它。 PTCParameter 履带参数（移动） 仅在 GetGroundType() 返回 TrackController（IsTrackController() 为真）时显示。 MultiFireSystemData 旧版多炮塔系统（弃用） 旧版多炮塔列表，新载具不要新增。 simpleVehicleFireSystemParameters 新版多炮塔系统 当前多炮塔配置列表，元素类型为 SimpleVehicleFireSystemParameter。 vehicleSelfExplosionParams 自爆数据（杂项） 元素类型为 VehicleSelfExplosionTextParameter 的数组，按数组元素填写。 PTCParameter 的显示由 GetGroundType() 的判定顺序决定：isStationary → Stationary，MechParameter.isMech → MechController，LuaVehicleControllerParameter.isLua → Lua，ShipControllerParameter.isShip → Ship，其余情况才返回 TrackController。因此只把模型做成履带车，并不保证该字段出现。 sharedGunData 和 sharedTurretData 是共享引用：多个载具指向同一资产时，修改会影响所有引用者；没有共享引用时才分别使用 TFParameter 或 MTParameter。教学样例保留了 sharedGunData 引用，所以该样例中 TFParameter 不显示；这对只练习生命值与视野的步骤没有影响。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 MCP 可按路径查询高级参数和显示条件，等价于定位数据。截图窗口目前不能自动选择 Odin 标签页；若新增教程需要标签页截图，应由 Codex 补该能力后再重拍。这里不改高级参数。 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/sharedGunData" }, "expect": { "contains": "SharedGunData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/noSharedGunData" }, "expect": { "contains": "False" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/noSharedTurretData" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTankFireParam", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TankFireParameter" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTurretParam", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TurretParameter" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetGroundType", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TrackController" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PTCParameter" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/MultiFireSystemData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/simpleVehicleFireSystemParameters" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleSelfExplosionParams" } } ] 4. 检查 确认 AssetName 和 editorAssetGuid 未变，PSParameter.Health 与 PSParameter.viewRange 已写入目标资产。 Inspector 截图只能证明字段位置与分组，不能证明运行时效果；要确认实际表现，需要在游戏内做一次检查。 如果后续需要调整高级参数，先确认上表的显示条件，再去对应分组里寻找字段。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 "Tutorial_VehicleTextData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/AssetName" }, "expect": { "contains": "TutorialTank" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/editorAssetGuid" }, "expect": { "contains": "${editorGuid}" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health" }, "expect": { "contains": "1200" } }, manual/en/component/fmod-play-component..title: Configure an FMOD Playback Component | Panzer War Document
manual/en/component/fmod-play-component..summary: Configure an FMOD Playback Component 中文 | English The MCP examples use separate teaching assets. ${variables} come from the shared recipe. Run this command at the repository root to create the sample, execute each group and capture both languages through the same local Unity MCP routes. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fmod-play-component --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Teaching-fixture preparation only; official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Fmod.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This page describes FmodPlayComponent: a MonoBehaviour that plays a configured FMOD event when its GameObject is enabled. 1. Component Add FmodPlayComponent to the GameObject that should emit sound. This example saves the component in a separate Tutorial_Fmod.prefab for reuse. Place that object at the required sound origin when using it in a scene. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent" } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Event eventReference is a private [SerializeField] EventReference struct, not a draggable ScriptableObject. Choose a real event in the inspector event picker, for example event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "list", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.EventManager/Events", "fields": "Path,Guid/Data1,Guid/Data2,Guid/Data3,Guid/Data4", "search": "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit", "count": 5 }, "expect": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)" }, "capture": { "Data1": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 1, "as": "int" }, "Data2": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 2, "as": "int" }, "Data3": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 3, "as": "int" }, "Data4": { "regex": "\\n\\d+\\tevent:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)\\t(-?\\d+)", "group": 4, "as": "int" } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.EventManager/EventFromPath", "args": [ "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "parameter:/engine01_cockpit/zoom" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "eventReference": { "Path": "event:/aircraft/engines/engine01/engine01_cockpit", "Guid": { "Data1": "${Data1}", "Data2": "${Data2}", "Data3": "${Data3}", "Data4": "${Data4}" } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Parameters Expand playParams, add one entry and set key = zoom, value = 0.5. The PlayParm fields are a string and a float, passed to setParameterByName before playback. The recipe queries the current event cache to confirm that the example event exists and defines zoom. For another event, use its actual parameter names. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "playParams": [ { "key": "zoom", "value": 0.5 } ] } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent)/playParams/0/key" }, "expect": { "contains": "zoom" } } ] 4. Lifetime and distance Enable isCustomSoundMaxDistance, then set the revealed customSoundMaxDistance to 75. The field is hidden while the override is off. The defaults are false and 50. This is a check before starting playback, rather than a continuously updated attenuation range. OnEnable calls Play. If the camera is too far away at that point, playback does not start or automatically resume when it gets closer. An empty event, an unavailable pool or a failed bank load also prevents playback. Disabling or destroying the component cancels pending waits. With isStopEventOnDisable = true, an existing instance is returned to the pool; false takes the ReleaseEvent path and does not guarantee immediate silence. Keep it true for this example. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent", "values": { "isStopEventOnDisable": true, "isCustomSoundMaxDistance": true, "customSoundMaxDistance": 75 } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.FmodPlayComponent)/customSoundMaxDistance" }, "expect": { "contains": "75" } } ] The recipe verifies the prefab, event reference and parameter readback. Audible output, bank loading and in-game distance behavior still require runtime verification.

official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleTextData.asset", "sharedGun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedGunData.asset", "vehicleData": "${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleData.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar-SharedGun.asset", "${sharedGun}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/AssetPathToGUID", "args": [ "${asset}" ] }, "capture": { "editorGuid": { "regex": "\\(String\\) ([a-f0-9]{32})" } } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/AssetName", "value": "TutorialTank" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/editorAssetGuid", "value": "${editorGuid}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/sharedGunData", "value": "@asset:${sharedGun}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/fireSpread/aimTime", "value": "2" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/fireSpread/dispersion", "value": "0.35" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] } VehicleTextData is the ScriptableObject that holds a vehicle's configuration. This page covers selecting the asset, locating fields, entering values and checking the result in the Unity Inspector. 1. Select the asset In the Project window, select the .asset whose main type is VehicleTextData. Its create menu is A Panzer War - 装甲纷争/G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具/Base - 载具配置/Vehicle Configuration - 载具配置参数. If you create a new asset, assign it to vehicleTextData on the target VehicleData. The pictures use a separate teaching sample named Tutorial_VehicleTextData; select the actual vehicle asset you are authoring in your project. Check that AssetName (shown as Default Asset Name. Do not modify it!) and editorAssetGuid (shown as Asset GUID) belong to the target vehicle. Both are read-only and cannot be edited here. editorAssetGuid is the Unity authoring-asset GUID, not the queue vehicleGuid. The queue vehicle ID comes from VehicleInfo.GetLoadGUID(). The two are different and must not be substituted for each other. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions CreateAsset is the asset-creation equivalent; assigning a live object with inspect_set is the reference-slot equivalent. The sample is assigned to a separate VehicleData. Read-only identifiers are queried only. [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleTextData)", "${fixture}/Tutorial_NewVehicleTextData.asset" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleData)", "${vehicleData}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicleData}/vehicleTextData", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/AssetName" }, "expect": { "contains": "TutorialTank" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/editorAssetGuid" }, "expect": { "contains": "${editorGuid}" } } ] 2. Set HP and view range Expand PSParameter. It is under the Base BoxGroup and is labelled Player State Params. Inside PSParameter, find PSParameter.Health under the Camera Control group; it is labelled HP. The code default is 1200, and this example also uses the teaching value 1200. In the same PSParameter, find PSParameter.viewRange under the Sight group; it is labelled View Range. The allowed range is 220–5000, the code default is 220, and this example uses the teaching value 600. Save the asset, then reselect it and confirm HP and View Range were written to the target asset rather than another one. HP=1200 and viewRange=600 are teaching values only, not official balance guidance. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Paths use real code field names and remain stable across UI languages. Asset writes save the asset; reselect and read back the values to verify. [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health", "value": "1200" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/viewRange", "value": "600" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/SaveAssets", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "null" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health" }, "expect": { "contains": "1200" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/viewRange" }, "expect": { "contains": "600" } } ] 3. Advanced groups Select the relevant Mobility, Fire, Turret or Multi-Turret tab before locating a field below. The Misc group is below the tabs. Field Inspector group and label Visibility and read behavior sharedGunData Shared Gun Data (Fire) Always shown; when set, GetTankFireParam() returns its tankFireParameter. TFParameter Tank Fire Params (Fire) Shown only when sharedGunData is empty; GetTankFireParam() then returns it. sharedTurretData Shared Turret Data (Turret) Always shown; when set, GetTurretParam() returns its turretParameter. MTParameter Turret Params (Turret) Shown only when sharedTurretData is empty; GetTurretParam() then returns it. PTCParameter Track Params (Mobility) Shown only when GetGroundType() returns TrackController, i.e. IsTrackController() is true. MultiFireSystemData Old Multi-Turret (Deprecated) Legacy multi-turret list; do not add it to new vehicles. simpleVehicleFireSystemParameters New Multi-Turret Current multi-turret list; each element is a SimpleVehicleFireSystemParameter. vehicleSelfExplosionParams Self Explosion Params (Misc) An array of VehicleSelfExplosionTextParameter; fill it element by element. PTCParameter visibility follows the order inside GetGroundType(): isStationary → Stationary, MechParameter.isMech → MechController, LuaVehicleControllerParameter.isLua → Lua, ShipControllerParameter.isShip → Ship, and only the remaining case returns TrackController. A tracked model does not by itself guarantee the field. sharedGunData and sharedTurretData are shared references: when several vehicles point to the same asset, edits affect every referencing vehicle; use TFParameter or MTParameter only when no shared reference is assigned. The teaching sample keeps a sharedGunData reference, so TFParameter is hidden there; this does not affect the HP and View Range steps above. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions MCP paths locate advanced data and visibility conditions directly. The capture window cannot yet select Odin tabs automatically; Codex must add that capability before a tutorial needs such a capture. This group does not alter advanced settings. [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/sharedGunData" }, "expect": { "contains": "SharedGunData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/noSharedGunData" }, "expect": { "contains": "False" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/noSharedTurretData" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTankFireParam", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TankFireParameter" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTurretParam", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TurretParameter" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetGroundType", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "TrackController" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PTCParameter" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/MultiFireSystemData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/simpleVehicleFireSystemParameters" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleSelfExplosionParams" } } ] 4. Check Confirm AssetName and editorAssetGuid are unchanged and HP and View Range were written to the target asset. An Inspector screenshot proves only field positions and labels, not runtime behavior; confirm actual behavior with a check in game. If you later adjust advanced parameters, check the visibility conditions in the table above first, then look for the field in its group. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions This recipe verifies the asset reference, identifiers and persisted fields. The sample has no complete driveable model, so gameplay is not verified. A successful capture is not a runtime pass. [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicleData}/vehicleTextData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_VehicleTextData" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/AssetName" }, "expect": { "contains": "TutorialTank" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/editorAssetGuid" }, "expect": { "contains": "${editorGuid}" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/Health" }, "expect": { "contains": "1200" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/PSParameter/viewRange" }, "expect": { "contains": "600" } } ]

manual/en/mod/fixed-angle-reload.html.summary: Fixed-Angle Reload Configuration 中文 | English The MCP examples use separate teaching assets. ${variables} come from the shared recipe. Run this command at the repository root to create the sample, execute each group and capture both languages through the same local Unity MCP routes. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fixed-angle-reload --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Teaching-fixture preparation only; official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "sharedGun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_FixedAngleReload_SharedGunData.asset", "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_FixedAngleReload_VehicleTextData.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar-SharedGun.asset", "${sharedGun}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } } ] } Fixed-angle reload uses the gun buff TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff. After firing or switching shell type, it can wait for a configured delay, constrain turret angles and scale rotation speeds. The constraint is removed after reloading finishes. 1. Prepare shared gun parameters In the Project window choose Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Shared Data - 共享数据 > Gun - 炮管 to create SharedGunData. Expand tankFireParameter and find the Buffs reference list, buffRefs. This recipe copies an existing gun configuration to preserve its initialization data. Editing shared gun data affects all referencing vehicles. For a change to one vehicle, create a separate shared-data copy, or clear that vehicle's sharedGunData before editing its own TFParameter. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${sharedGun}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter" }, "expect": { "contains": "TankFireParameter" } } ] 2. Add the fixed-angle reload buff Add an entry to buffRefs, choose TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff and expand its configuration. Use these teaching values: Field Teaching value and meaning hasDelay / delay Enable the delay and set it to 0.5 seconds isTraverseLocked Enable Lock Traverse hasSpecificTraverseAngle / specificTraverseAngle Enable the specific traverse angle and set 0 degrees hasSpecificElevationAngle / specificElevationAngle Enable the specific elevation angle and set 5 degrees isOverrideTraverseSpeed / overrideTraverseSpeedCoff Override traverse speed with -0.5, a 50% reduction isOverrideElevationSpeed Leave disabled to preserve elevation speed Delay, angle and speed-coefficient fields are shown when their respective switches are enabled. When no specific angle is supplied, the code uses the current angle on entering the fixed-angle state. These values illustrate configuration only. The current list is AbstractTankFireBuffCasterSafeRef[]; the legacy buffs field is deprecated. The MCP recipe creates a real SafeRef entry by supplying both its type and configuration JSON. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Whole-array JSON assignment creates real SafeRef entries with the type name and serialized configuration. The recipe verifies persisted data and leaves deprecated buffs untouched. Set Match identity and name Guid — tutorial-queue-001; a plain string, not a Unity asset GUID Vehicle Queue Type — select Match Queue Name — expand it, set Default Name to Tutorial Queue An empty Guid is generated automatically. Keep each published queue's identifier unique and stable; tutorial-queue-001 is only the pictured example. Add one vehicle entry In Vehicle Guids click + to add one entry, then fill its two strings: Comment = an author note, Vehicle Guid = the vehicle load identifier. The identifier is what VehicleInfo exposes: assetGuid, or the lower-cased vehicleName when assetGuid is empty. Copy it from your own driveable VehicleInfo; do not use the Unity .meta GUID or VehicleTextData.editorAssetGuid. Select that VehicleInfo asset and click Copy Asset GUID to copy the correct identifier, then paste it into Vehicle Guid. The example Comment: T-34-85 No.215 with Vehicle Guid: a922ecf1-f7ce-45f9-b0f8-86a23ec26c2c is official AAA2 content, illustrative only, and not automatically supplied to your project. The list is a set of eligible vehicles, not quantities: the item count is the entry count, and there is no spawn quantity field. How many vehicles actually appear is decided by mode settings. This fixture has no model, is excluded from the pack and cannot be driven. For release, select a real driveable VehicleInfo and include its content or dependencies. Whole-list JSON assignment adds and fills entries; there is no quantity field. Pack with the vehicles The asset's Guid is its bundle name with variant vehiclequeue: <Guid>.vehiclequeue Add the asset to the mod build pipeline's Linked Objects (linkedObjects) Entries are strings, so they do not pull in the vehicles: put each referenced vehicle's content in this pack or an installed dependency Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions This builds the queue-definition teaching package and excludes the recreated VehicleInfo metadata. A successful build does not supply the T-34 model. Real use requires vehicle content or a mod dependency. manual/en/mod/vehicle-hatches.html.summary: Vehicle Hatch Configuration Tutorial 中文 | English The MCP examples use separate teaching assets. ${variables} come from the shared recipe. Run this command at the repository root to create the sample, execute each group and capture both languages through the same local Unity MCP routes. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-hatches --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Teaching-fixture preparation only; official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hatch.prefab", "sourceMesh": "${fixture}/Tutorial_HatchSource.obj" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This tutorial uses a separate Tutorial_Hatch.prefab to show hatch markers, moving parts and double-sided meshes. The example contains teaching nodes and a mesh rather than a complete vehicle. Field spellings match the source. 1. Add and register the component Add VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent to the hatch object and expand hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment to edit its nested configuration. On the same object, configure VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery: set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the hatch component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion automatically; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. Check that the companion references the current hatch component. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "HatchCenter", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "HatchPivot", "HatchPivot/HatchMesh" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Hatch centre, hand markers and hinge hatchRadius=0.5; hatchTransform is the hatch opening centre. leftHandSlotTransform and rightHandSlotTransform are hand placement markers, not the moving hinge or pivot. The moving pivot is each activeParts entry's activePartTransform: assign the independent moving pivot to activePartTransform with identity initial local rotation. Expected check: the hatch centre sits at the opening, hand markers are not used as hinges, and the pivot starts at identity rotation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "hatchRadius": 0.5 } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.hatchTransform", "child": "HatchCenter" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.leftHandSlotTransform", "child": "LeftHand" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.rightHandSlotTransform", "child": "RightHand" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Configure movement isSemiOpen=false shows activeParts. Each entry uses axis=(1,0,0), activeAngle=90, closeAngle=0, moveSpeed=120. At runtime localRotation=Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle,axis) overwrites the local rotation; it does not add a delta. isSemiOpen is a state or display condition; setting it does not guarantee runtime code disables existing activeParts animation. Expected check: the pivot starts at identity rotation, so the result does not depend on the original orientation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "isSemiOpen": false, "activeParts": [ { "axis": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 0 }, "activeAngle": 90, "closeAngle": 0, "moveSpeed": 120 } ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.activeParts.Array.data[0].activePartTransform", "child": "HatchPivot" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Save and check Verify the component, pivots and movement values, including the runtime discovery condition. Save the prefab and read back the moving pivot reference, moveSpeed and companion type. In-game opening, crew hand placement and complete vehicle loading still require runtime verification. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/activePartTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "HatchPivot" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/moveSpeed" }, "expect": { "contains": "120" } } ] 5. Bake double-sided meshes when needed If an open hatch needs visible backfaces, assign the relevant MeshFilter entries to doubleSidedMeshFilters. In the vehicle attachment configuration editor, click the double-sided mesh bake button and choose an output folder under Assets. doubleSidedMeshes is generated output, not a list to fill manually. Limit this to the moving regions that need backfaces to avoid doubling the entire vehicle's triangle count. The recipe demonstrates the input and output references with a separately copied quad mesh. It calls the same baker with an explicit output folder, bypassing the interactive folder dialog. Repeated baking updates generated meshes while preserving GUIDs. Temporarily enabled source Read/Write settings are restored afterwards. This verifies mesh data and references, not the final rendered appearance. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Light/AuthoringSamples/Square.obj", "${sourceMesh}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "references": [ { "property": "m_Mesh", "asset": "${sourceMesh}", "type": "UnityEngine.Mesh" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "doubleSidedMeshFilters": [ {} ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.doubleSidedMeshFilters.Array.data[0]", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.VehicleHatchMeshBaker/BakePrefab", "args": [ "${asset}", "", "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "_DoubleSided_" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/doubleSidedMeshes/Length" }, "expect": { "contains": "1" } } ]

manual/en/mod/vehicle-light-component.ht.summary: VehicleLightAttachment Guide 中文 | English The MCP examples use separate teaching assets. ${variables} come from the shared recipe. Run this command at the repository root to create the sample, execute each group and capture both languages through the same local Unity MCP routes. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-light-component --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Teaching-fixture preparation only; official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Light.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This example configures a circular low-beam light. VehicleLightAttachment is serialized configuration data; VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent is the component attached to a GameObject. Field names keep their original C# identifiers. 1. Create the component and bind the object Create a light object in the vehicle prefab and add VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent. Expand lightAttachmentSlot, then attachment, and assign the light origin to lightTransform. This example uses a separate Tutorial_Light.prefab with a node named LightOrigin. The same object needs VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery. Set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the light component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion when drawing the light Inspector; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "LightOrigin" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "child": "", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "references": [ { "property": "lightAttachmentSlot.attachment.lightTransform", "child": "LightOrigin" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Shape and size Set the shape to Circle. Circle and HalfCircle show radiusSize; this example uses 0.3. Rectangles use rectSize instead, and CustomShape uses customShapeRenderers; the existing Light/AuthoringSamples assets are a reference. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightSizeType": 0, "radiusSize": 0.3 } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Appearance and visibility Set lightType to LowBeam, baseColor to white, and emissionColor to HDR white with intensity 3.5 as in this example. Keep isAlwaysVisible = true and isBlinker = false, and turn off isAutoNaming. Enabling isBlinker reveals frequency and phase fields. The defaults, blinkerFrequency = 1 and blinkerStep = 0.5, are examples rather than the only working values. lensEmitters contains lens-glare sampling nodes, up to eight entries; beamOrigin specifies a separate beam origin. Leave both empty for this basic Circle setup. These fields are distinct from Unity Light components. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightType": 0, "baseColor": { "r": 1, "g": 1, "b": 1, "a": 1 }, "emissionColor": { "r": 3.5, "g": 3.5, "b": 3.5, "a": 1 }, "isAlwaysVisible": true, "isBlinker": false, "isAutoNaming": false } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Verify Check the object binding to lightTransform, that the companion runtime components were saved, that the Circle radius and colors were written, and that lensEmitters has at most 8 entries; Inspector screenshots show field locations and values, not runtime behavior, so look at the light in game once as well. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/specificAttachmentMonoComponent" }, "expect": { "contains": "--- VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent ---" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent)/lightAttachmentSlot/attachment/lightTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "LightOrigin" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent)/lightAttachmentSlot/attachment/radiusSize" }, "expect": { "contains": "0.3" } } ]

manual/en/mod/zoom-ratio-config.html.summary: Configure Vehicle Zoom Ratios 中文 | English The MCP examples use separate teaching assets. ${variables} come from the shared recipe. Run this command at the repository root to create the sample, execute each group and capture both languages through the same local Unity MCP routes. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run zoom-ratio-config --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Teaching-fixture preparation only; official assets are not modified. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ZoomProfile.asset", "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleTextData.asset", "gun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedGun.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This tutorial sets the binocular and sight zoom ratio ranges of a vehicle with a ZoomProfileData asset. Field names are kept exactly as they appear in the source. 1. Create a ZoomProfileData asset In the Project window choose Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Base - 载具配置 > Zoom - 倍率 to create a ZoomProfileData asset. Expand Zoom Name (zoomName) and set Default Name to Tutorial Zoom. This example uses separate teaching assets and leaves existing vehicle configurations untouched. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.ZoomProfileData)", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/zoomName/defaultName", "value": "Tutorial Zoom" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Set the zoom ratio range minRatio defaults to 1.9 and maxRatio defaults to 3.5. Use positive ratios and keep minRatio less than or equal to maxRatio; this is an author constraint, with no validation here in code. The example sets minRatio = 2 and maxRatio = 8 as the low and high endpoints. At runtime these two values become the available ratio range: BaseVehiclePawn.GetZoomRatio reads minRatio and maxRatio from binocularZoomProfileData for binocular zoom and from zoomProfileData for sight zoom, and falls back to built-in ranges when the asset is null. VehicleCameraZoom then converts the ratio into a horizontal field of view and interpolates within that range. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio", "value": "2" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio", "value": "8" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "2" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "8" } } ] 3. Vision override and thermal vision Enable Is Vision Override (isVisionOverride) to reveal Is Thermal Vision (isThermalVision). Both default to false; this example sets both to true. A runtime thermal lock can still disable thermal vision, so the setting does not guarantee an unconditional in-game effect. If you do not want to change the vision mode, keep both flags false; the zoom ratios still apply. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isVisionOverride", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision" }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } } ] 4. Assign it to vehicle parameters Choose the reference slot by purpose: binoculars use VehicleTextData.PSParameter.binocularZoomProfileData; the sight uses zoomProfileData on the active gun parameters. With sharedGunData, set tankFireParameter.zoomProfileData on that asset. Without a shared reference, set TFParameter.zoomProfileData on the vehicle. The same profile asset can be assigned to both slots. Save the parameter assets and read the references back. This recipe verifies editor assets and references; in-game FOV, thermal effects and mod loading remain unverified. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Assigning a live object is equivalent to dragging the profile into a reference slot. This sample creates separate parameter assets and reads the references back; camera and thermal effects are not verified in game. [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleTextData)", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SharedGunData)", "${gun}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PSParameter/binocularZoomProfileData", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${gun}/tankFireParameter/zoomProfileData", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedGunData", "value": "@asset:${gun}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PSParameter/binocularZoomProfileData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ZoomProfile" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTankFireParam()/zoomProfileData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ZoomProfile" } } ]

manual/gameplay/config-files.html.title: 2. 配置文件 Configuration Files | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/config-files.html.summary: 2. 配置文件 Configuration Files 为了让玩家能够高度自定义游戏的数值系统，开放了相关配置文件。 To let players customize the game's stat system to a high degree, the relevant configuration files have been opened up. 使用方法：将 battleConfig.yaml.default 改名为 battleConfig.yaml（即删除 .default 后缀），该配置文件即可生效。 How to use it: rename battleConfig.yaml.default to battleConfig.yaml (that is, remove the .default suffix), and the configuration file will take effect. battleConfig.yaml.default 路径： Path of battleConfig.yaml.default: 安卓：Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/saves/battleConfig.yaml.default Android: Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/saves/battleConfig.yaml.default 电脑：SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/PanzerWar-DE/dlc/PanzerWar-DE/saves/battleConfig.yaml.default PC: SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/PanzerWar-DE/dlc/PanzerWar-DE/saves/battleConfig.yaml.default 修改规范 Editing Rules System.Single 表示可以填写整数或小数。 System.Single means you may enter either a whole number or a decimal. System.Int32 表示必须填写整数。 System.Int32 means you must enter a whole number. 修改数值后，请确保文件后缀为 .yaml，即可进入游戏体验不同的设置。 After changing the values, make sure the file still has the .yaml extension, then launch the game to try out your different settings.

manual/gameplay/crash-and-launch-problem.title: 5. 闪退 & 无法进入问题解决方案 Crashes & Failure to Launch: Solutions | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/crash-and-launch-problem.summary: 5. 闪退 & 无法进入问题解决方案 Crashes & Failure to Launch: Solutions 此文档记录了一些版本问题及其解决方案。 This document records some of the version-related problems that have been reported, together with their solutions. 灰屏卡住 Stuck on a Grey Screen 将 Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods 文件夹重命名为 PanzerWarMods-Bak，进入游戏，在车库左侧点击模组，申请外部 SDCard 权限。然后退出游戏，将 Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods-Bak 重命名为 PanzerWarMods。 Rename the folder Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods to PanzerWarMods-Bak, launch the game, open Mods on the left side of the garage, and click to request external SDCard permission. Then quit the game and rename Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods-Bak back to PanzerWarMods. 闪退 Crashes 在升级版本后，若进入某个场景发生闪退，可能是由部分老旧数据不兼容导致。解决方案：备份游戏存档，然后删除游戏，重新安装游戏。请务必查看备份存档！ If the game crashes when you enter a scene after upgrading to a new version, the crash may be caused by some old data that is no longer compatible. Solution: back up your game saves, then uninstall and reinstall the game. Be sure to read the "Backing Up Saves" section below first! 备份存档 Backing Up Saves 手动备份存档 Backing Up Saves Manually 注意：请务必按如下步骤逐步操作，切勿跳过任何步骤！ Note: follow the steps below one by one, and never skip a step! 打开文件管理器，选择目录 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves，长按选择复制，复制到 Android / data 目录下。 若同时想要备份模组，可将 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / Mods 长按复制到 Android / data 目录下。 删除游戏，重新安装。 正常打开游戏至车库，然后退出游戏。 将 Android / data / saves 目录复制到 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves 下。 打开游戏，确认数据。 若要恢复模组数据，请完成步骤 1 的备份。然后，将 Android / data / Mods 目录复制到 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / Mods 下。 打开游戏，确认 Mod。 Open your file manager, select the directory Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves, long-press it to copy it, and paste it into the Android / data directory. If you also want to back up your Mods, long-press Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / Mods and copy it into the Android / data directory as well. Uninstall the game, then reinstall it. Launch the game normally, go all the way to the garage, then quit the game. Copy the Android / data / saves directory into Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves. Launch the game and check that your data is there. To restore your Mod data, you must have made the optional Mods backup described in step 1. Then copy the Android / data / Mods directory into Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / Mods. Launch the game and check that your Mods are there.

manual/gameplay/definitive-edition-troub.title: 8. 决定版运行问题 Definitive Edition Troubleshooting | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/definitive-edition-troub.summary: 8. 决定版运行问题 Definitive Edition Troubleshooting 账号或密码错误 Account or password is not correct 在此输入新的密码，随后你的邮箱会收到重置密码的邮件，点击其中的链接，然后新密码才能生效。 Enter your new password here. manual/gameplay/game-debugging-tools.htm.title: 1. 游戏调试工具 Game Debugging Tools | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/game-debugging-tools.htm.summary: 1. 游戏调试工具 Game Debugging Tools 热更下载渠道修改 Changing the Hot-Update Download Channel 默认情况下，游戏会下载生产环境的热更文件。通过修改一个文件，可使游戏改为从测试环境下载热更新。测试环境的热更新通常比生产环境的更新，但也意味着可能存在 Bug。如果在测试环境中遇到 Bug，请及时上报给开发者。 By default the game downloads hot-update files from the production environment. By editing one file, you can make the game download hot updates from the test environment instead. Hot updates on the test environment are usually newer than the ones on production, but that also means they may contain bugs. If you run into a bug on the test environment, please report it to the developers promptly. 切换方式： 需正常进入游戏车库一次，然后打开 /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/env.txt，将 prod 修改为 staging 并保存文件即可。 How to switch: launch the game and reach the garage once, then open /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/env.txt, change prod to staging, and save the file. 校验 DIY 资源是否完整 Verifying That DIY Resources Are Complete 调试窗口中增加了一些调试指令： Several debug commands have been added to the debug window: DebugDIY DebugMapDIY DebugVehicles 输入调试指令后，点击回车即可执行调试指令。输入 help 可查看所有调试指令。 Type a debug command and press Enter to run it. To list all of the debug commands, type help. 用于检查是否有部分资源在制作时或安装后损坏，从而导致游戏卡死。 They are used to check whether some resources were damaged while being made, or after they were installed, which can cause the game to freeze. 由于此检查会遍历所有已读取的资源，因此过程会比较漫长。 The check goes through every resource that has been loaded, so it takes quite a while. 如果要检查是否有 DIY 忘记生成预制体，请输入 DebugDIY。 If you want to check whether a DIY item is missing its generated prefab, type DebugDIY.

manual/gameplay/install-mods.html.title: 0. 模组安装教程 Mod Installation Tutorial | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/install-mods.html.summary: 0. 模组安装教程 Mod Installation Tutorial Note: When downloading files, be mindful of your operating platform and distinguish between the mod packages for the iOS, Android, and Windows platforms! 注意：下载文件时，请注意你的运行平台，注意区分 iOS、Android、Windows 平台的模组包！ Installation 安装方式 Android 安卓平台 After downloading the Mod file, select our game as the application to open it. 模组文件下载后，请选择我们的游戏作为打开方式。 How to install Mods in bulk: 批量安装模组的方式： Note: do not select too many Mods at once. Select a dozen or so, then launch the game once, so that the Mods install correctly. 注意：一次不要选择太多模组，选择十多个后启动一次游戏，以确保模组正常安装。 Windows 电脑平台 Move the Mod file to one of the following locations: Standard Edition: steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\mods\Installs Definitive Edition: steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\mods\Installs HD Test Version: steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\mods\Installs Then, start the game. 将模组文件移动至以下位置之一： 普通版：steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods\Installs 或决定版：steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\Mods\Installs 或高清测试版：steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\Mods\Installs 然后启动游戏即可。 iOS 苹果平台 In your system's file manager, manually move the downloaded mod package into the mods/Installs directory inside our game's folder. For the Definitive Edition, the folder is named "Panzer War," and for the Standard Edition, it's named "WarOfTanks Arcade." 在系统的文件管理器中，将下载的模组包手动移至游戏目录下的 mods/Installs 目录中。 决定版的文件夹名为 "Panzer War"，普通版的文件夹名为 "WarOfTanks Arcade"。

manual/gameplay/map-editor-tutorial.html.title: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/map-editor-tutorial.html.summary: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial 案例地图分享码： Share code of the example map: c564f128-6d1b-4db5-84a2-953b1de0d52c -[Map]-[simplemap] 地图制作注意事项 Notes on Making a Map 必须包含 Tag，TeamAStartPoint（A 队出生点）与 TeamBStartPoint（B 队出生点）之间应保持一定距离。 使用空气墙组件，拉伸模型以围住地图边缘。 警惕 Z-Fighting 引起的抖动，避免模型完全重叠，否则会导致模型闪烁。 The map must contain the tags TeamAStartPoint (Team A spawn point) and TeamBStartPoint (Team B spawn point), and they should be placed a certain distance apart from each other. Use the air wall component and stretch its model to enclose the edges of the map. Beware of the flickering caused by Z-Fighting. Do not let models overlap completely, otherwise they will flicker back and forth. 运行时可能遇到的问题 Possible Issues at Runtime 无法出生。设置的 Tag 数量过少或距离过近。 远距离看不见自己摆放的小细节物体。出于优化考虑，仅在工坊中显示所有物体，运行时会根据 LOD 策略选择物体的细节等级。 Unable to spawn. Too few tags were set, or they are placed too close to each other. Small detail objects you placed are not visible from a distance. For optimization reasons, all objects are displayed only in the workshop; at runtime the level of detail of an object is chosen according to the LOD policy.

manual/gameplay/ravenfield-map-support.h.title: 7. Ravenfield 地图模组支持 Ravenfield Map Tool Support | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/ravenfield-map-support.h.summary: 7. Ravenfield 地图模组支持 Ravenfield Map Tool Support 版权合规 Copyrights 注意，请勿将没有版权的 Ravenfield 地图提交到我们游戏的创意工坊，我们会立刻进行删除处理。在使用此功能前，请确保你拥有正版的 Ravenfield。 如果你是 Ravenfield 的地图所有者，我们欢迎你将你的 Ravenfield 地图直接提交到装甲纷争的创意工坊！ Attention! You are not allowed to submit a Ravenfield map to our workshop if you do not have the copyright. And please be sure you have owned Ravenfield in Steam first! If you are the owner of the Ravenfield map, you are welcome to submit it to our workshop!!! 介绍 Description 针对 Steam 的普通版，我们增加了对 Ravenfield 创意工坊的支持。 For Panzer War : Lit on Steam, we add support for Mod tool maps from Ravenfield. Step.1 如何获取 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图？How to get Ravenfield Mod maps? 打开 Ravenfield 的创意工坊 https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools，订阅 Mod Tool 的 Mod 地图，然后在本地的 SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480 路径找到对应的 rfl 文件，此文件即为 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图。 Open the workshop of Ravenfield. https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools Subscribe Mod Tool Maps. Then you can find rfl files from SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480. Step.2 如何给装甲纷争安装 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图 How to install it for Panzer War? 将 Ravenfield 的 rfl 结尾的地图，放在 SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps 路径下，即可使用 Ravenfield 创意工坊的 Mod 地图。同时，在游戏启动后，会在地图文件路径处生成一份 Yaml，可用于自定义出生点以及寻路点的坐标。 Place rfl files to SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps. Then open the game. A yaml file will be created after game is opened, you can change the yaml to custom the spawn points and patrol points. Q&A 如果出生点出生在异常位置，请使用进阶配置，调整自定义出生点。 If the start point is wrong, please use custom points. 部分地图会导致游戏 Crash。 Some maps will crash game. 进阶：如何配置自定义出生点 Advance: Configure custom points 在放完 rfl 文件后，重新启动一次游戏。即会在 rfl 同目录下，生成一个 yaml 文件。 将 isCustomPoints 的 false 改为 true，修改下方 x,y,z 坐标为想要的位置。 Config the yaml file created in step.2 # @Comment: 是否自定义出生点 @Type: System.Boolean isCustomPoints: false # @Comment: A 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: B 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamBSpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customPartolPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Int32 tileSize: 512 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Single voxelSize: 2 可添加多个出生点以及寻路点，如下图所示。 customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 - x: -4 y: 0 z: -4 - x: 4 y: 0 z: 4 进阶：如何打包为 ModPackage Advance: Pack it as a ModPackage 将 rfl 与对应 yaml 文件用 zip 形式进行压缩，然后将后缀从 zip 改为 mod package，将文件命名改为 StandaloneWindows64_任意名称.modpack，即可随地图与出生点配置信息分享给其他人。 Compress the rfl file and its matching yaml file into a zip archive, then change the extension from zip to mod package and rename the file to StandaloneWindows64_AnyName.modpack. You can then share the map together with its spawn point configuration with other people.

manual/gameplay/runtime-log.html.title: 3. 游戏运行日志显示 Displaying the Game Runtime Log | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/runtime-log.html.summary: 3. 游戏运行日志显示 Displaying the Game Runtime Log 游戏日志是分析游戏卡死原因的主要手段之一。 The game log is one of the main ways to analyze why the game freezes. 开启游戏日志 Enabling the Game Log 出于性能考虑，游戏默认关闭日志。若需要开启，请在模组文件夹中新建一个空文件并命名为 log.debug。请确认系统显示了文件扩展名，避免实际文件名变成 log.debug.txt。 For performance reasons, the game disables logging by default. To enable it, create an empty file named log.debug in the Mods folder. Make sure your system is showing file extensions, so that the actual file name does not end up as log.debug.txt. 模组文件夹各平台路径 Path of the Mods folder on each platform 安卓决定版：/sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/ Android Definitive Edition: /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/ 安卓普通版：/sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarOpenSource/files/mods/ Android Standard Edition: /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarOpenSource/files/mods/ 电脑普通版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods PC Standard Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods 电脑决定版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\Mods PC Definitive Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\Mods 电脑HDRP版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\Mods PC HDRP Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\Mods 对于安卓设备，若已安装 adb 环境，也可以使用如下 adb 命令： On an Android device with adb installed, you can also use the following adb command: adb shell touch /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/log.debug 调试日志显示 Viewing the Debug Log 随后，你可以在游戏内调试窗口中查看运行日志。使用方法：点击右上角的“自定义”，滚动至底部并开启调试日志。点击新出现的框即可查看报错信息。 After that, you can see the runtime log in the in-game debug window. How to use it: click Customize in the upper-right corner, scroll down to the bottom, and turn on the debug log. Click the box that appears to view the errors. 电脑版日志文件 Log Files on PC 电脑普通版： C:\Users\你的用户名\AppData\LocalLow\ShanghaiWindy\PanzerWar\Player.log PC Standard Edition: C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\LocalLow\ShanghaiWindy\PanzerWar\Player.log 电脑决定版： C:\Users\你的用户名\AppData\LocalLow\ShanghaiWindy\PanzerWar-DE\Player.log PC Definitive Edition: C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\LocalLow\ShanghaiWindy\PanzerWar-DE\Player.log

manual/mod/continuous-build.html.title: 18. 持续构建（脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/continuous-build.html.summary: 18. 持续构建（脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) 创建持续构建流程，可以更快地迭代更新模组文件。你可以高度自定义打包哪些模组以及将其拷贝至哪个文件夹，全程无需手动操作，也无需打开 Unity 点击任何按钮。 Setting up a continuous build pipeline lets you iterate on Mod files faster. You can freely customize which Mods are built and which folder they are copied to, without doing anything by hand and without opening Unity to click any button. 1. 创建一个 manifest 描述 json Create a manifest json modNames 为一个数组，填写你要构建的模组包列表。 modNames is an array; fill in the list of mod packages you want to build. copyInfo 会根据平台，将最终生成的文件拷贝到指定目录。（安卓工程则只拷贝安卓文件，Windows 工程则只拷贝 Windows 文件） copyInfo copies the generated files to the given directory according to the platform. (An Android project only copies the Android files, a Windows project only copies the Windows files.) isPackage 为 true 则拷贝 modpackage；为 false 则拷贝 buildpipline 原始资源（用于上传 Steam 创意工坊）。 When isPackage is true the modpackage file is copied; when it is false the raw buildpipline assets are copied instead (these are the ones you upload to the Steam Workshop). 案例 TestBuildPipline.json Example TestBuildPipline.json 构建模组包 BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes 与 BuildPipline-Vehicles，生成 modpackage 文件。 将安卓平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Android-Ship，将电脑平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Windows-Ship。 Build the mod packages BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes and BuildPipline-Vehicles into modpackage files. Copy the Android assets to D:/Projects/Android-Ship and the desktop assets to D:/Projects/Windows-Ship. { "infos": [ { "modNames": [ "BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes", "BuildPipline-Vehicles" ], "copyInfo": [ { "platform": "Android", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Android-Ship" }, { "platform": "StandaloneWindows64", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Windows-Ship" } ], "isPackage" : true } ] } 2. CI 脚本 CI Script 调用 ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest，传入 -config 参数（manifest 路径）。 Call ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest and pass the -config argument (the path of the manifest). 案例 BuildPiplineCI.sh Example BuildPiplineCI.sh projectDir 为你的 Unity 项目路径。 projectDir is the path of your Unity project. manifestDir 为步骤 1 中 manifest 的 json 文件路径。 manifestDir is the path of the manifest json file from step 1. editorDir 为你的 Unity 安装路径。 editorDir is the path where Unity is installed. logPath 为你的打包日志输出路径。 logPath is the output path of the build log. （在 Windows 上执行 bash，可安装 Git，然后通过 Git Bash 执行以下脚本。） (To run bash on Windows, install git and then run the following script through git bash.) projectDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP" manifestDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\TestBuildPipline.json" editorDir="H:\UnityEditor\2021.3.0f1\Editor\Unity.exe" logPath="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\log.txt" $editorDir -projectPath $projectDir -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config $manifestDir -logFile $logPath 完整的构建案例，可直接查看 PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI 文件夹。 调整 BuildPiplineCI.sh 中的路径为你自己项目的路径，用 Git Bash 方式执行即可。 For a complete build example, look at the PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI folder. Change the paths in BuildPiplineCI.sh to the ones of your own project and run it through git bash. 3. Jenkins 集成 Jenkins Integration Jenkins 安装与配置教程 4. 特殊情况 Special Cases 1. BuildPipline 位于 ModManager 的子文件夹 BuildPipline in a Subfolder of ModManager 在这种情况下，设置 modNames 名称时，也需要加上前缀。 In this case the name you write in modNames has to carry the prefix as well. 例如，模组位于 Assets/ModManager/**AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX**。 For example, for a Mod located at Assets/ModManager/AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX 则填写 **AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX**。 you write AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX.

manual/mod/create-mech.html.title: 05. Create Mech 创建机甲 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/create-mech.html.summary: 05. Create Mech 创建机甲 在阅读本文档之前，请务必具备普通坦克模组的开发经验。 Before reading this document, make sure you already have experience developing a normal tank Mod. 前期准备 Preparation 1. 模型 Model 骨骼模型：一个绑定骨骼的机甲模型。 Skeletal model: a mech model with a rigged skeleton. 伤害模型：一个将各个关节分离的简易伤害模型。 Damage model: a simple damage model with each joint separated. 2. 动画 Animation 你至少需要拥有以下动画： 待机动画 走路动画：笔直向前走路动画，向左的走路动画，向右的走路动画，原地左转的动画，和原地向右的动画。 You need at least the following animations: Idle animation Walking animations: walking straight forward, walking to the left, walking to the right, turning left in place, and turning right in place. 注：倒退走路动画可以在动画树中，以 -1 倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward walking animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 你可以额外制作以下动画： 飞行动画：飞行起步动画，飞行中待机动画，和飞行结束落地动画。 You can additionally create the following animations: Flight animations: the take-off animation, the in-flight idle animation, and the landing animation at the end of the flight. 3. 导入引擎动画的设置 Animation Import Settings 动画导入引擎后，需进行相关设置，才能使机甲符合物理模拟效果。 After the animations are imported into the engine, a few settings are required so the mech matches the physics simulation. 勾选 Root Transform Position (Y) 中的 Bake Into Pose。 Tick Bake Into Pose under Root Transform Position (Y). 在 Curves 中增加 GravityWeight 属性，并将曲线设置为值为 1 的水平线。 Add a GravityWeight property under Curves, and set the curve to a horizontal line with a value of 1. 在包含脚步落地帧的动画中，于 Events 中添加 WalkSound 事件。 On the animation frames where a foot touches the ground, add a WalkSound event under Events. 载具属性设置 Vehicle Property Setup 机甲预制体制作 Building the Mech Prefab 动画控制器。在含有 Animator 组件的物体上增加 MechAnimatorController 组件和 CharacterController 组件。 Animator controller. On the object that holds the Animator component, add the MechAnimatorController component and the CharacterController component. 物理碰撞。调整 CharacterController 的属性，使胶囊体底部与脚底一致。 Physics collision. Adjust the CharacterController properties so that the bottom of the capsule lines up with the soles of the feet. 机甲脚底碰撞。在机甲两个脚底均增加 MechLegEndPoint 组件和 BoxCollider 组件，并勾选 BoxCollider 的 isTrigger 属性。若机甲可以飞行，则增加 MechFireBurst 组件，并调整相应参数。 Mech foot collision. Add a MechLegEndPoint component and a BoxCollider component to both of the mech's feet, and tick the isTrigger property on the BoxCollider. If the mech can fly, also add the MechFireBurst component and adjust its parameters. 炮塔同步。增加 Turret/Gun/Dym 的空物体。在机甲模型上，于上半身旋转控制的位置增加 MechTurretSync 组件，以同步相应位置。 Turret sync. Create empty objects for Turret/Gun/Dym. On the mech model, add the MechTurretSync component at the position that drives the upper-body rotation, so the corresponding positions stay in sync. 动画树制作 Building the Animator Controller 在 Project 中新增 Animator Controller，并将其拖入机甲预制体含 Animator 的组件上。 Create a new Animator Controller in the Project window and drag it onto the Animator component of the mech prefab. 增加如下参数。类型一定要与图中一致。 Add the parameters shown below. The types must match the picture exactly. 增加动画状态。若含飞行的三个状态动画，则一定要与图中的三个 Jet 开头的动画命名一致。 Add the animation states. If you include the three flight state animations, their names must match the three Jet-prefixed animation names in the picture. 向前走路（Walk）由多个动画的混合组成（Blend Tree）。混合使用的参数为 Turn。0.5 为笔直向前的动画，0 为向左的走路动画，1 为向右的走路动画。可以在中间插入更多动画作补帧，使动画更加自然。 Walking forward (Walk) is a blend of several animations (a Blend Tree). The blend parameter is Turn: 0.5 is the straight-forward animation, 0 is the walk-left animation, and 1 is the walk-right animation. You can insert more animations in between to fill in the motion and make it look more natural. 注：倒退动画可以在动画树中，以 -1 倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 动画转换条件。在下图出现的连线，需要增加如图的条件。 Transition conditions. The transitions shown in the pictures below need the conditions shown in those pictures. 向前走路动画条件 Walk forward condition: 向后走路动画条件 Walk backward condition: 向左走路动画条件 Walk left condition: 向右走路动画条件 Walk right condition: 若含飞行动画，则飞行落地动画条件 If you include flight animations, the flight landing condition: 从 Idle 转到其他状态，无需设置 Has Exit Time。其他状态转到 Idle，则需要设置 Has Exit Time。 Transitions from Idle to other states do not need Has Exit Time. Transitions from other states back to Idle do need Has Exit Time. 注意：游戏的输入为 Walk 与 Turn。Walk 的范围为 -1 到 1，Turn 的范围为 0 到 1。可以根据自己的动画，设置更加复杂的动画切换。动画系统的条件切换可以在引擎内直接进行调试，可访问 Unity 动画教程了解更多详情。 Note: the game's inputs are Walk and Turn. Walk ranges from -1 to 1, and Turn ranges from 0 to 1. You can set up more complex animation transitions to suit your own animations. Animation transition conditions can be debugged directly inside the engine — see the Unity animation tutorials for more details. 创建 VehicleData Creating VehicleData 像普通坦克一样，创建载具配置参数。然后删除生成的 VehicleTrack 文件。 Create the vehicle configuration parameters just like you would for a normal tank, then delete the generated VehicleTrack file. 其他配置信息和坦克一样进行配置即可。 All the other configuration can be done exactly the same way as for a tank. 在 VehicleTextData 中需要额外关注，设置机甲专用参数。 VehicleTextData needs extra attention: set the mech-specific parameters there.

manual/mod/custom-shader-data.html.title: 32. Custom Shader Data 自定义着色器 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/custom-shader-data.html.summary: 32. Custom Shader Data 自定义着色器 32. Custom Shader Data 自定义着色器 Create Data 创建数据配置 Create the custom shader data from out menu. 如图所示，创建自定义着色器数据。 \ Pick your custom material. If you do not know about Unity material system, please search about the Unity material and shader graph tutorials. 选择自定义材质。如果不了解 Unity 的材质系统，请搜索 Unity Material 以及 Shader Graph 相关教程。 Config Component 配置组件 Add CoreRPMatComponent component to your model and toggle on is component based. You need to assign the guid from custom shader data to your component. Ensure the urp and hdrp should be different guids. 为模型添加 CoreRPMatComponent 组件，勾选“基于组件数据”，并将自定义着色器数据的 GUID 分配给该组件。请注意，URP 与 HDRP 需使用不同的 GUID，且材质文件需在不同的管线下打包。 Build 打包 If the shader is only for one vehicle, you can just put the CustomShaderData with VehicleInfo to pack. If it is for public resource purpose, you should pack it separately. 如果着色器仅用于单个载具，建议直接将 CustomShaderData 与 VehicleInfo 放在一起打包。如果是作为公共资源，则建议单独打包，并填写包依赖关系。 Advance 进阶知识 The logic behind custom shader data We use the custom material on your custom shader data and copy your material properties to the material you linked on CoreRPMatComponent. The material you linked will keep the following properties (They will not be overrided by your custom material). If you want to use the following properties you should keep the same name as the following table. 此功能原理： 我们使用自定义着色器数据中指定的自定义材质，并将其材质属性（包括各种勾选项和下拉框的值）覆盖到通过 CoreRPMatComponent 关联的材质上。 CoreRPMatComponent 关联的材质会保留以下属性（这些属性不会被自定义材质覆盖）。如果希望自定义着色器使用以下属性，请确保自定义着色器中的通道名称与下表保持一致。 Channel Name 通道名称 Type 类型 Description 介绍 _BaseMap Texture2d Diffuse map 漫反射贴图 _BumpMap Texture2d Normal map 法线贴图 _MaskMap Texture2d Mask map Unity URP 的 PBR 贴图 _Smoothness float Smoothness 光滑度 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword Enable camouflage 是否启用涂装 _CamoPatternMap Texture2d Camouflage Pattern Map 涂装的样式图 _CamoPatternTiling Vector4 Camouflage Pattern Tiling 涂装的样式图的缩放比 _CamoBlackTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map back channel 黑色通道对应颜色 _CamoRedTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map red channel 红色通道对应颜色 _CamoGreenTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map green channel 绿色通道对应颜色 _CamoBlueTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map blue channel 蓝色通道对应颜色 _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO_COLOR_TEX keyword Enable texture camouflage 是否启用贴图的涂装 _Lerp float (Clamp in 0-1) Lerp between camouflage 涂装颜色占比 _DirtRange float (Clamp in 0-1) Lerp between dirty 污渍占比 _DirtTex Texture2d Dirt texture 污渍贴图 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword Enable dirty 启用污渍贴图 Some Special Channel Usage 一些特殊通道的用法 _CamoPatternMap 涂装的样式图 Usage Split rgba channel and lerp with tint color 用法：提取 RGBA 通道，并使用 lerp 与 tint 颜色进行混合。 Vehicle Custom Shader 载具自定义着色器 Pick custom shader type as Custom Vehicle Option 着色器类型选择“自定义载具选项”。 Change the channel name to your name defined in shader. 将下方的通道名称更改为 Shader 中定义的名称。 How to support the dirt effect? 如何适配污渍效果？ When the _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword is enabled, the vehicle's AO map is blended with _DirtTex at the strength given by _DirtRange. 当 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT 关键词启用时，载具的 AO 贴图将与 _DirtTex 按照 _DirtRange 指定的强度进行混合。

DIY 地图工程导入 DIY Map Project Import 拉取 DIY 素材 Pull the DIY Assets 本仓库包含 DIY 地图的美术素材及配置文件。导入 Yaml 配置是必需的。 This repository contains the art assets and the configuration files for DIY maps. Importing the Yaml configuration is required. 使用 git 拉取项目 Pull the project with git： https://gitlab.waroftanks.cn/modder/ShanghaiWindyMaps 打开 URP 工程场景 Open the URP Project Scene 确保已拉取默认的模组工程，然后使用 Unity 打开 UnityURPProject 文件夹。 Make sure you have pulled the default Mod project, then open the UnityURPProject folder with Unity. 导入包 Import the Package 打开 Package Manager，导入本地的 DIY 素材包。 Open Package Manager and import the local DIY asset package. 选中这两个文件夹下的 package.json。 Select the package.json under each of these two folders. 正确安装后，素材和配置都会显示已装配至工程。 Once installed correctly, both the assets and the configuration will show as added to the project. 导入 DIY 地图的 Yaml，该文件位于游戏的 saves 文件夹下。 Import the Yaml of the DIY map, which is located in the game's saves folder. 导入后，即可对场景进行编辑与修改。可通过打包成模组场景的方式发布此地图。 After importing, you can edit and modify the scene. You can publish the map by building it as a Mod scene. 若仅修改了位置，也可以选择导出地图的 Yaml。 If you only changed positions, you can also choose to export the Yaml of the map.
