manual/mod/tank-shell-ejection-animation.summary: 02.8 樱花的坦克抛壳动画 Tank Shell Ejection Animation (by 樱花) 一、Blender内准备 Part 1: Preparation in Blender 我们需要在 Blender 中设置好抛壳装置的旋转位置（如果没有抛壳装置，请忽略这一步）。以 AGS 为例，我们需要将物体原点设置到旋转中心，如图所示： Step 1: In Blender, set up the rotation position of the shell ejection mechanism (skip this step if there is no shell ejection mechanism). Taking the AGS as an example, we need to move the object origin to the center of rotation, as shown below: 将弹壳放入炮塔内，并设置为炮管或炮塔的子级： Step 2: Place the shell casing inside the turret and make it a child of the gun barrel or of the turret: 注：如果抛壳装置的旋转轴不是 x、y 或 z 轴（以 T72A 为例），可以创建一个空物体，将其旋转到与抛壳装置相同的角度，并将抛壳装置设置为该空物体的子级。这样在 Unity 中只需旋转空物体即可，如下图所示： Note: if the rotation axis of the shell ejection mechanism is not the x, y or z axis — the T72A for example — you can create an empty object, rotate it to the same angle as the shell ejection mechanism, and make the mechanism a child of that empty object. Then in Unity you only need to rotate the empty object, as shown below: 二、Unity内制作 Part 2: Authoring in Unity 首先打开 Unity 的 Animation 组件： Step 1: First open Unity's animation component. 选定需要制作动画的模型后，点击 Create 创建动画： Step 2: After selecting the model you want to animate, click Create to create the animation. 设置动画文件名称后，点击保存： Step 3: Enter a name for your animation file, then click Save. 点击 Add Property，可以在 Transform 中创建位置、旋转、大小三种变换。这里我们选择位置 Position；如果需要动画过程中旋转，也可以添加 Rotation。 Step 4: Click Add Property. Under Transform you can create three kinds of transformation — position, rotation and scale. Here we choose Position; if you also need rotation during the animation, you can add Rotation as well. 动画的制作可以参考如下链接中的视频： Step 5: For making the animation itself, refer to the video at the following link: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV17t4y1F7CZ/?spm_id_from=333.788&vd_source=5f5f291242e9ace2af6f7105ccc768bf 在动画制作过程中，可以点击下方的 Curves 调整动画曲线： While creating the animation, you can click Curves at the bottom to adjust the animation curves. 注：对于旋转轴不是 x、y 或 z 的模型，我们需要将坐标系调整到局部坐标（Local）下来制作动画，如下图所示： Note: for models whose rotation axis is not x, y or z, we need to switch the coordinate system to Local when creating the animation, as shown below: 同时需要调整旋转为四元数（Quaternion）旋转模式（需要在制作动画之前设置，否则动画过程不会生效，需要重新制作）： You also need to switch rotation to quaternion rotation mode (this has to be set before you create the animation, otherwise it will not take effect during the animation and you will have to redo it): 三、组件设置 Part 3: Component Setup 增加 Animation 组件，如下设置： Step 1: Add an Animation component and configure it as shown below: 点击制作的动画，进入 Debug 模式，勾选 Legacy 后，返回 Normal 模式： Step 2: Select the animation you created, switch to Debug mode, tick Legacy, then switch back to Normal mode: 确保 Wrap Mode 模式为 Default： Make sure Wrap Mode is set to Default. 挂载 Lua 脚本组件： Step 3: Attach the Lua script component: Lua 代码如下： The Lua code is as follows: local PlayAnimationComponent = class("PlayAnimationComponent") Behavior() Property = { } function PlayAnimationComponent:OnStarted() local animation = self.script:GetNativeComponent("Animation") local ret, vehicle = self.script:TryGetTankInitSystem() if ret then VehicleAPI.RegisterVehicleLoadedEvent(vehicle, function() VehicleAPI.RegisterBulletFiredEvent(vehicle, 0, function() local isPlayed = animation:Play() end) end) end end return PlayAnimationComponent 至此动画制作完成。 The animation is now complete.

ORM 贴图的通道约定为：R = Ambient Occlusion、G = Roughness、B = Metallic。使用 RGBA Merge 节点，将三张灰度贴图分别连接到 R、G、B 输入，并将结果按线性颜色空间导出。 The channel convention for an ORM texture is R = Ambient Occlusion, G = Roughness, B = Metallic. Use the RGBA Merge node to connect the three grayscale textures to the R, G and B inputs respectively, then export the result in linear color space. 若要调整已有 ORM 贴图的通道，请先用 RGBA Split 拆分，再通过 RGBA Merge 按上述顺序重新连接。以下截图仅作为节点连接方式参考。 To rearrange the channels of an existing ORM texture, split it with RGBA Split first, then reconnect the channels in the order above with RGBA Merge. manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.title: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.summary: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 1. Upload Standards 上传规范 每个分支应尽可能减少修改内容。理想情况下，一个分支仅包含一辆坦克或一架飞机的修改。切记，不要在一个分支内提交大量载具修改后再进行合并，此类合并将无法通过。 Each branch should contain as few changes as possible — ideally one branch per tank or aircraft. Never commit a large batch of vehicle changes on a single branch and then ask for a merge; such merges will not be accepted. 2. Naming Standards 命名规范 任何文件名应以大写字母开头，随后接小写字母，例如： Every file name should begin with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, for example: 任何文件都应具有清晰明确的名称，而非一串乱码。 Every file should have a clear, meaningful name instead of a string of gibberish. 尽量避免拼写错误。 Try not to misspell words. 3. When Modifying an Existing Model, Replace the Fbx Instead of Adding a New One 在原本模型上进行修改，应替换 Fbx 而非新增 Fbx 导出新的 fbx 并覆盖原本的 fbx 文件。此步骤可在建模软件导出时执行，或在文件夹中通过复制文件进行覆盖。无法在 Unity 编辑器内直接完成。如果在 fbx 内新增了模型，请将新的 fbx 拖入空场景，然后将新增部分复制到原本的旧预制体内。 Export the new fbx and overwrite the original fbx file. You can overwrite it while exporting from your modelling software, or by copying the file over in the folder. This cannot be done directly inside the Unity editor. If you added new models inside the fbx, drag the new fbx into an empty scene, then copy the newly added parts into the original old prefab. 切记，不要因为对 fbx 新增一块区域的模型，就只是新增一个 fbx 文件。这会导致出现 XXX_fix.fbx、XXX_fix2.fbx 等文件，造成项目文件混乱。 Never add a separate fbx file just because you added one more piece of geometry. It leads to XXX_fix.fbx, XXX_fix2.fbx and so on, which turns the project files into a mess. 4. Do Not Reuse One Texture for Both Normal and RGB Maps, and Do Not Set Normal Strength 法线图与 RGB 图不要用一张，不要设置 Normal 强度 解决方法： Solution: 在建模软件中，不要将 RGB 图引用给 Normal，也不要设置 Normal 强度。 In your modelling software, do not feed the RGB map into Normal, and do not set the Normal strength. 例如，在 Blender 中删除以下节点： For example, in Blender, delete the following node: 以及删除以下节点： And delete the following node as well: 5. Avoid Duplicate Materials 避免重复的材质球 重复的材质球指的是使用相同贴图但应用了不同材质球的情况。这会增加渲染压力。 Duplicate materials means separate materials that use exactly the same textures. This increases the rendering cost. 重复的材质球通常出现在 Blender 中使用 Ctrl+C 和 Ctrl+V 复制物体时。我们建议使用 Shift+D 的方式复制物体，以避免创建重复的材质球。 Duplicate materials usually appear after copying objects in Blender with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V. We recommend duplicating objects with Shift+D instead, so that no duplicate material is created. 对于已经创建的重复材质球，需要在 Blender 中手动将引用的材质球统一替换为相同的材质，以避免重复。 For duplicates that already exist, you have to switch the referenced materials manually in Blender so that they all point to the same material. 下拉框可以显示目前还有哪些材质存在重复，通常重复的材质名称会以 .001、.002 结尾。 The dropdown shows which materials are still duplicated; duplicated ones normally end with .001, .002 and so on. 可以使用上方的搜索框搜索重复的材质名称。 You can use the search box above to look up duplicated material names.

manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.title: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.summary: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 We understand that creating Mods is not easy, but due to reasons such as model accuracy and data parameters, you may encounter dissatisfaction from some players. Please ensure you are mentally prepared before proceeding with the upload. 我们明白制作模组不易，但由于模型考据、数据参数等原因，你可能会遭到部分玩家的不满。请确保你已经做好充分的心理准备再进行上传。 Upload Qualifications 上传资格 All Mod authors can upload their Mods without undergoing a review process. However, only Mods that are original are eligible for upload. Please ensure that the Mods you upload comply with the CC BY-NC license. By uploading a Mod, you agree to the principles of free and open sharing, making the Mod freely available for distribution by any player without restrictions. Note: Mods with copyright disputes will not qualify for incentives. 所有模组作者可以无需审核直接上传模组。但请确保上传的模组为原创。上传的模组必须遵守 CC BY-NC 协议。上传即代表自愿公开流通模组，同意模组以自由的方式传播，不限制任何玩家进行传播。注意：上传的模组若存在版权争议将无法获得激励金。 Tool Usages 工具用法 Open the tool - 打开工具 Enter Your Account - 输入你的账号密码 Configure your account and click save at the bottom 配置你的账号，然后点击底部的保存选项 Pick the account by clicking this button 点击此按钮选择你的账号 Pick File 选择文件 Pick a mod package file to upload, or pick a folder by the second button 选择模组文件进行上传，或者通过第二个按钮，批量上传文件夹中的 mod package 文件 If you need to upgrade the Mod, then need to change the version. +1 version to make it upgradable. 若模组需要进行更新，则需要进行版本变更，需要 +1 的版本号，才可正常进行更新。 Contract with us 与我们签订创作激励收益 Once your original, high-quality, and free Mod achieves a certain number of downloads on the Mod downloader, we will offer you an incentive agreement. This agreement will provide a reward ranging from 50 to 500 SGD, depending on the quality of your Mod. Please note that a Singapore bank account is required to receive the reward. 一旦你的原创、高质量、免费的模组在模组下载器上达到一定的下载量，我们将与你签订激励协议。根据模组的质量，我们会提供 50 至 500 新币不等的奖励。请注意，需要提供一张新加坡银行卡来接收奖励。 Prohibition of Illegal Use of Mods 禁止非法利用模组 It is strictly forbidden for any user to utilize uploaded public Mods and their related files for illegal fundraising, fraud, or commercial activities in any form. If such behavior is discovered, we will pursue legal action in accordance with the law. 严禁任何使用者以任何形式利用已上传的公开模组及其相关文件进行非法集资、诈骗或商业活动。如发现此类行为，我们将依法追究相关法律责任。

manual/mod/vehicle-basics.html.summary: 02.1 Vehicle Basic 载具基础 Preparation 准备 Assets: Vehicle Model with textures and Vehicle HitBox Vehicle Engine Sounds(Start,Idle,Running) Fire Sound(Near and Far) Recommended software for art: Blender 2.7 Blender is a free software for modeling. It can be used for making the vehicle model and the hitbox model. You can download it from https://www.blender.org/download/. Substance Painter & Photoshop Set up Mod project environment in GetStarteds 资源: 模型，贴图，与载具伤害模型 载具引擎音效 （包括 启动，待机，运行） 载具开火音效 （包括近，远） 推荐的美术相关软件 Blender 2.7 Blender 是一个免费的建模软件，你可以从官网 https://www.blender.org/download/ 下载安装。我们可用 Blender 制作载具的模型与伤害模型。 Substance Painter 与 PhotoShop 设置模组的开发环境 （查看文档 1 项目初始化） Process the Vehicle Model 预处理载具模型 Before getting started, you should learn about 3D modeling software. Blender is recommended because it is free and small. The following tutorial will use Blender as the modeling software. 在开始之前，你应该要掌握至少一个 3D 建模软件的使用。 我推荐你使用 Blender ，因为他免费。 在接下来的教程中，我都将使用 Blender Child-Parent Relationship and naming 父子关系与命名 The wheels,turret,gun and dym(barrel) of the vehicle model should have a correct child-parent relationship and name. The child-parent relationship should look like this. 载具模型的车轮、炮塔（Turret）、主炮（Gun）、炮管（Dym）需要设置正确的父子关系与命名。 父子关系应如下表所示。 ** ** ** ** ** ** MainBody LeftWheel l_1-l_n LeftUpperWheel l_1-l_n LeftTrack RightWheel r_1-r_n RightUpperWheel ru_1-ru_n RightTrack Turret Gun Dym You should have objects with names above. You should not miss any of it. LeftWheel,LeftUpperWheel,RightWheel,RightUpperWheel are empty objects. MainBody,Turret,Gun,Dym are model. 你的载具的物体名称需要与上表保持一致，不能遗漏任何一个。 LeftWheel,LeftUpperWheel,RightWheel,RightUpperWheel 是空物体 MainBody,Turret,Gun,Dym 是模型 You can refer the following videos Model pre-process from websites https://youtu.be/M0aoe-EPTjs Preprocessing for Tank Destroyer https://youtu.be/Ex-P-mdSWJk 你可以参考如下的视频 模型分离教程 https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1U5411x7s3 Model Export 模型导出 Axis 轴向 2.13 Blender 修正模型轴向 Scale 缩放 Create Vehicle HitBox 创建载具伤害模型 The HitBox Model is used for penetration system. You should separate HitBox to pieces. Every piece of HitBox will have their own armor thickness after being imported to the game engine. In addition, it is not recommended to have a very precise hitbox model. It will affect performance. 伤害模型用于游戏的击穿系统，你需要将不同装甲数值的模型分成不同的物体。导入引擎后，每一块伤害模型都可以单独设置自己的装甲厚度。此外，不建议伤害模型面数很高，会影响游戏性能。 HitBox Naming 载具伤害模型命名 2.12 HitBox Naming 伤害模型命名规范 Model Optimization 模型优化 Number of model faces should not be larger than 20,000. Number of materials should not be larger than 4. Texture should not larger than 2048 x 2048 Number of hitbox faces should not be larger than 5,000 模型面数不应该超过 2万面 模型材质数不应该超过 4个 贴图分辨率不应该超过 2048 x 2048 伤害模型面数不应该超过 5千面 2.13 Blender 修正模型轴向 Import Model and set materials 设置模型与材质 Before getting started,you should have a quick view of the basic control of the Unity Engine. Open the project which is mentioned in the 1. GetStarted 项目初始化 . Create a folder in the project window in the Unity Engine,and drag your models into that folder. Set up the materials. 在开始下面步骤之前，你应该先了解 Unity 引擎的一些基础操作。 打开在项目初始化中提及的模组项目环境 1. GetStarted 项目初始化 在项目中创建一个文件夹，将你的模型拖入其中。设置相关材质。 Set Up Collision 设置碰撞 Drag the vehicle model from the project window to the Hierarchy window to set up the collision. Add box colliders to the MainBody and Turret. Modify the size of box collider to suit the MainBody and Turret. Note: the MainBody collider must not be set too low, otherwise the hull of the vehicle will get stuck on the terrain and the vehicle will not be able to move. Then,create a subfolder in your folder and name it Collision.Drag your model from the Hierarchy Windows into that folder. You can refer the Template-Vehicle folder. 将模型从 Project 窗口拖入 Hierarchy 窗口，进行碰撞的设置。 对 MainBody 与 Turret 物体增加 Box Collider 组件。 根据模型来调整其大小。 注意： MainBody 的 碰撞不可以设置太低，会导致载具底盘被地形卡住无法移动。 在设置完碰撞后，将模型从 Hierarchy 窗口再拖回至 Project 窗口，保存为预制体（Prefab）。 这个就是你的载具碰撞预制体文件了。你可以参考 Template-Vehicle 示例文件夹。 Create Vehicle Data 创建载具数据 Mod Editor 模组编辑器 You should find Framework/1. Editor Tool in the top windows bar alternatively short key Ctrl+G to open Editor Tools ,if there are no errors in the console. 你应该可以在顶部菜单栏 游戏框架/1. 编辑器工具 ，或者按 Ctrl + G 快捷键，以打开创建窗口 Click Open Create Vehicle Button 点击 Open Create Vehicle 按钮 Create Vehicle Data Editor 创建载具数据编辑器 Input the name of your vehicle. Then,click Create Vehicle button. The name of the vehicle should only contain letters, numbers and underscores. Do not contain blanks! It will not load on certain platforms. 输入载具的名称，然后点击 Create Vehicle 按钮进行创建。载具名称只可以包括字母，数字和下划线。不要包含空格，会导致某些平台加载异常。 These files will be created after you clicked. 当按下按钮后，这些文件会被创建。 In the following,I will guide you how to set them one by one. 接下来我会一步步教你怎么设置如下的组件，你可以按照顺序一一设置。 1. VehicleInfo 载具描述数据 You can set vehicle name,rank and other basic info in VehicleInfo. 你可以在 VehicleInfo 设置载具的名称，等级以及其他一些基础信息 2. Vehicle HitBox 载具伤害模型 Data Binding 数据设置 Assign the variable External Armor Model with your HitBox model. Click Create Prefab Button. 将你的伤害模型 拖入 External Armor Model 中 点击 生成预制 按钮 Click Open Edit Mode Button 点击 编辑模式 按钮 Edit Mode 编辑模式 Click Generate HitBox Model. 点击 Generate HitBox Model 按钮。 You will notice that the HitBox Model is generated in the scene. 你会看到伤害模型已经在场景中生成。 Armor Thickness and Type 装甲厚度与类型 You can set the armor thickness by clicking it. 点击对应的部件，即可设置它的装甲厚度。 HitBox Parent 伤害模型父子关系 Drag HitBox gameobject to Main,Turret,Gun,Dym depending on its type. 拖拽 HitBox 物体，根据其类型放置到 Main,Turret,Gun,Dym 物体下 Module Place 模块放置 You need to set module if you want it can be damaged in module mode. 如果你需要载具在模块模式下可以被损坏，则需要设置内部模块 Select Module Type and click **Spawn **Button 选择模块类型，点击放置按钮 Place it to right position and right parent. 将模型放置于正确的位置和父节点下 Module HP 模块血条 Every module has its hidden HP. You can set it individually. Also, you can set it automatically. Set the total hit point and click Auto Assign Internal Module Hit Points. 每个模块有一个隐藏的血条机制，你可以为每个模块独自设置。 此外，你可以设置一个总血量，然后分配给每个模块。 Module Crew 模块载具职业 For crews,you need to toggle on their role 对于乘员，你需要设置他们的职业 Module Ammo Shell 模块弹药架 For Ammo Shell, you need to set bounds for ammo shell to control how the ammo shell change when capacity change. 对于弹药架，你需要设置边界，来控制弹药数量变化时，弹药架的变化。 Double click vehicle hitbox prefab and set the internal module component on the AmmoShell gameobject. 双击你载具生成的 VehicleHitBox 的预制体，找到 AmmoShell 物体上挂载的 InternalModule 组件 Click **Add new bounds **button and resize it to fit the ammo shell. Click Create Cache Button to generate mesh data. Press Ctrl + S to save the prefab. 点击 **添加新边界 **按钮，调整其大小 点击 **创建模型缓存 **按钮，生成相关数据 点击 Ctrl + S 来保存对预制体的修改 Save prefab 保存预制体 To save the edit of hitbox,you need to click Save as prefab and connect button. 为了保存伤害模型的预制体，你需要点击保存并链接为预制体按钮。 3. Vehicle EngineSound Data 载具引擎数据 Drag your sound files to the project window. And assign the variables one by one. 将对应的音效文件拖入。 4. Vehicle Text Data 载具详细参数数据 Create Bullet Related Assets 创建子弹相关资源 We need to create fire sound assets and bullet data assets first. 我们需要先创建开火音效资源，与炮弹资源。 By right clicking the project window,you can create fire sound asset and bullet data asset. 右键点击 Project 窗口，你可以创建开火音效与炮弹资源。 FireSound Asset 炮声资源 Set the variable of Fire Near and Fire Far with fire sound. 拖入相应音效文件。 Bullet Data Asset 子弹 You need to select BulletVFX according to your ammo type. 你需要根据你的炮弹类型，来选择其特效文件。 VehicleTextData 载具详细数据 Set the vehicle data as you wish or according to the picture. 你可以按照自己的需要，或者参照图片来设置载具的数据。 Base Data 基础数据 Track 移动 Fire 开火 Turret 炮塔 Import Data From Tankgg 从 Tank GG 导入数据 You can import a part of track,turret and gun data from tankgg. You need to add other missing data!!! 你可以从tankgg 导入 一些相关数据，但你需要补齐其他的缺失数据。 5. Vehicle Data 载具打包数据 Assign the variable MainModel with the one that you have set the collider and click Open Edit Mode. 将设置了 Box Collider 的载具预制体模型拖入至 MainModel ，然后点击 Open Edit Mode。 Move and rotate the GameObject with orange icon to the right position and rotation. Then,press 'K' key to save the transform data of the selected GameObject to the vehicle data. Then,Click UnLock Inspector button to exit. 移动与旋转橙色的图标来将对应物体放置于合适的位置，点击 K 来保存相关信息。 点击 **UnLock Inspector **按钮退出 6. Wheel Collider 载具负重轮 Drag the WheelCollider and the main model into the scene so that you can edit the wheel collider data much more easier.After you set them,right click the variable with blue rect and click apply to prefab XXXX. 将 WheelCollider 和 载具模型拖入场景，然后设置 WheelCollider 的属性，并如图进行保存 You can refer to this picture to set the friction of the wheel collider. 你可以参考如下设置 7. Vehicle Track Data 载具履带 Assign the variable Track Mesh. (You can use Panzer_Track_Middle prefab if you don't prepare the single track model) And edit the Track Distance(You can leave it for default value now) Other data are generated by editor itself. So don't touch it unless you know what you are doing. 设置 Track Mesh. (如果你没履带素材，你可使用预制体 Panzer_Track_Middle ) 你可以设置 Track Distance(也可以保持默认数值) 其他数值由编辑器生成，不用碰他们 Drag the GameObject generated by VehicleData to Target Edit Object. Then Click the Load Suspension Data Button. (If you have deleted that GameObject. You can regenerate it by going back to VehicleData. Then Click Open Edit Mode and click UnLock Inspector) For your convenience,you can hide the HitBox from here. 将由 VehicleData 生成的模型拖拽到 Target Edit Object 中 然后 点击 Load Suspension Data 按钮. (如果你已经删除了 VehicleData 生成的模型的模型. 你可以回到 VehicleData. 然后 点击 Open Edit Mode 再点击 UnLock Inspector) 为了你操作方便，可以在这里隐藏伤害模型 Then,Click Create Node. Surround the track with your nodes. 然后,点击 Create Node. 如图，用顶点包围履带. When you have done it,you can click Preview Track. You can remove the static track to view the advance track more clearly. Click Unlock Inspector when you have finished editing the track. 完成此步骤后，你可以点击 Preview Track 来预览履带 （可移除静态履带获得更好的观察） 编辑完毕履带后点击 Unlock Inspector. 8. Build VehicleData to Prefab 打包载具 Find VehicleData and click Pack Asset. It will generate two prefabs located at Assets/Res/Cooked/xxxx_Pre and Assets/Res/Cooked/DedicatedServer/xxxx_Pre For the client,only the first one is useful. You will need to do this build task again if you have changed the hitbox or edit the node transform with orange icon. 找到 VehicleData 然后点击 Pack Asset. 他会创建两个物体 位于 Assets/Res/Cooked/xxxx_Pre and Assets/Res/Cooked/DedicatedServer/xxxx_Pre 第一个是客户端文件，第二个是服务器端文件. 如果你修改了碰撞模型，伤害模型或者橙色物体的位置，都需要重新进行此步骤 Create Mod Package 打包模组 Open Mod Manager again. 再次打开 Mod Manager . Name a package. You can't just name it as your vehicle name. You should name it in the following pattern Vehicle-XXXXXX. And click Create mod package Button. 命名 package. 你不能以载具名称来命名！！！会加载错误！！！. 你应该用以下方式来命名 Vehicle-XXXX (其中 XXXX 是你的载具名称). 然后点击 Create mod package 按钮. BuildPipline Drag your vehicle info to the linked object. And then,click the Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle button. 将 vehicle info 加入到 linked object 中. 然后点击 Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle 按钮. Press Ctrl + Shift + B to select your desired platform. Remember you can't run Mods with an incorrect build platform 点击 Ctrl + Shift + B 切换你要的平台. 模组必须使用相同的平台才能运行 ModPackageData Then click the Linked mod package.Edit the infos and click Package Now. 然后点击 Linked mod package.编辑信息然后点击 Package Now. Your modpackage will be generated at UnityProject\Build\Mod-Package. And its extension is modpackage.You can test it with the common installation. 你的模组文件会生成在 UnityProject\Build\Mod-Package. 扩展名为 modpackage. 可用与之前官方模组与社区模组一样的方式进行安装. If you switch the platform. You should go to the BuildPipline and click the Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle button. Then go to the Linked mod package and click Package Now. 如果你切换平台需要重新开始 BuildPipline 的步骤. If you have any issue during reading this tutorial,you can send an email to me. My E-mail: 403036847@qq.com Or Contact me on VK 如果你在阅读本教程过程中遇到任何问题，都可以 QQ 联系我 QQ:403036847 Special Vehicle Guidance 特别载具指南 Wheel Vehicles 轮式载具 For wheel vehicles,you should prepare the model like this. LeftTrack and RightTrack can be an empty gameobject but it can't be missing. 模型如上图准备 LeftTrack 和 RightTrack 可以是空物体，但不可缺少 You can refer this setting for your wheel vehicles. 轮式载具设置可以参考上图 Slot Gun 机炮 To make gun like M3 Stuart,you can refer this. 参考上图设置 Drum Gun 弹鼓炮 To make drum gun like Progetto 65,you can refer this. 参考上图设置 Advance Gun 弹夹炮 To make advance gun like Bat 25t,you can refer this. 参考上图设置 Multi-Turret 多炮塔 For example,bmd-1 is using the multi-turret mechanic to shoot common bullets and atgm. 以 BMD-1 的副炮导弹为例。 You should first prepare the model like this. 你需要按如上结构准备模型。 Then, configure like this. 然后，像这样配置数据。 Be careful! The position of ffpoint and fireeffect can only be set in the inspector. 注意，炮弹发射点与开火特效口由偏移控制。 T-35 example T-35 例子 Hierarchy: 父子结构 Vehicle Text Data: 数据参考 Two barrel example ST-II 双管例子 The pivot position of second barrel: 第二个炮管的模型坐标轴 Hierarchy: 父子结构 Vehicle Text Data: 数据 Issues you may encounter 你可能遇到的问题 Issues you may encounter 你可能遇到的问题

manual/mod/vehicle-dev-qa.html.title: 02.9 Q&A 疑难杂症解决 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/vehicle-dev-qa.html.summary: 02.9 Q&A 疑难杂症解决 Issues you may encounter 你可能遇到的问题 Game can't load the vehicle 载具无法正常加载 In this case, the reason might be that the name of your mod package is the same as the vehicle name. This is not allowed. Try another mod package name. For example, the mod package name can be Vehicle-XXXX (XXXX refer to the vehicle name) eg. Vehicle-T-72 这可能是因为你的模组包名与载具名一致所致。请尝试修改模组包名。例如，如果载具是 T-72，模组包名可设置为 Vehicle-T-72。 Game can't load the vehicle correctly 无法运行载具 In this case, the reason might be that your vehicle assets miss some reference. Please check if the following files are set correctly VehicleEngineSoundData, VehicleHitBox, FireSound Asset, Bullet Data Asset, VehicleTextData, VehicleTrack and VehicleData. You can refer to this document and you can refer to the template vehicle in the project. 这可能是因为你的载具资源存在引用丢失。请检查以下文件是否设置正确：VehicleEngineSoundData、VehicleHitBox、FireSound Asset、Bullet Data Asset、VehicleTextData、VehicleTrack 以及 VehicleData。你可以参考本文档，也可以参考工程中的模板载具。 Can't elevate the gun 无法抬升炮管 In this case, the reason might be that down max angle can't be negative. It should be positive. 请检查炮管俯角是否设置为负值，应设置为正值。 Tank Move Strange 坦克移动奇怪 Tank Mass 坦克质量 Do not set a too small or too large mass for the tank 不要将质量设置得过大或过小。 Wheel Collider Mass should not larger than 1000. You can refer this setting. Mass 质量不要超过 1000，悬挂系数参考如下设置。 Model Render Strange 模型渲染奇怪 This may caused by wrong normal direction. You can check the following settings. 这可能是由法线朝向错误导致，你可以检查如下设置。 Normal Map Type 法线贴图类型 If you imported normal map, you should set the texture type to Normal Map. 如果你导入了法线贴图，则应该将贴图类型设置为 Normal Map。 Mesh Normal 模型法线 Check face orientation, it should have no red color. Flip the normal of red faces. 检查面朝向，不应出现红色。请翻转红色面的法线朝向。 Index out of range 数组越界报错 Ensure all sub turrets bullet data length is not zero！确保所有副炮 BulletData 数组不为 0 祝昔的十万个为什么(1)

manual/mod/vehicle-hatches.html.summary: 载具舱门配置教程 中文 | English 下方 MCP 示例使用独立教学资产。${变量} 由共享配方提供；在仓库根目录运行以下命令可创建样例、逐组执行并重拍两种语言。调用经本机 Unity MCP 的相同路由执行。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-hatches --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 教学样例的准备操作（仅用于复现配图，不修改官方资产）。 { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hatch.prefab", "sourceMesh": "${fixture}/Tutorial_HatchSource.obj" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 本教程用独立的 Tutorial_Hatch.prefab 说明舱口标记、活动部件和双面网格配置。示例提供教学节点和网格，不包含完整载具；字段名保持源代码拼写。 1. 添加并注册组件 在舱盖物体上添加 VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent，展开 hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment 编辑嵌套配置。 同一物体上配置 VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent：将 attachmentSlotType 设为 Specific，specificAttachmentMonoComponent 引用舱盖组件，供运行时发现附件。项目 CustomEditor 会自动补这个伴随组件；配方显式创建并保存它。 检查伴随组件引用的是当前舱盖组件。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "HatchCenter", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "HatchPivot", "HatchPivot/HatchMesh" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. 舱口中心、手部标记与铰链 hatchRadius=0.5，hatchTransform 是舱口开口中心。 leftHandSlotTransform、rightHandSlotTransform 是手部放置标记，不是运动的铰链或枢轴。 运动枢轴来自各 activeParts 条目的 activePartTransform：把独立的运动枢轴赋予 activePartTransform，初始 local rotation 保持单位旋转。 预期检查：舱口中心位于开口处，手部标记未被当作铰链，枢轴初始旋转为单位值。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "hatchRadius": 0.5 } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.hatchTransform", "child": "HatchCenter" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.leftHandSlotTransform", "child": "LeftHand" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.rightHandSlotTransform", "child": "RightHand" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. 设置运动参数 isSemiOpen=false 时显示 activeParts。 每个条目：axis=(1,0,0)、activeAngle=90、closeAngle=0、moveSpeed=120。 运行时按 localRotation=Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle,axis) 设置，直接覆盖原 local rotation，不叠加增量。 isSemiOpen 是状态或显示条件；设置它并不保证运行时代码会禁用已有 activeParts 动画。 预期检查：枢轴初始旋转为单位值，旋转结果不依赖原始朝向。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "isSemiOpen": false, "activeParts": [ { "axis": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 0 }, "activeAngle": 90, "closeAngle": 0, "moveSpeed": 120 } ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.activeParts.Array.data[0].activePartTransform", "child": "HatchPivot" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. 保存并检查 校验组件、枢轴与运动参数，并确认运行时发现条件。 保存 prefab，读回活动枢轴引用、moveSpeed 和伴随组件类型。实际开合、乘员手部位置和完整载具加载仍需在游戏中确认。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/activePartTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "HatchPivot" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/moveSpeed" }, "expect": { "contains": "120" } } ] 5. 按需烘焙双面网格 打开舱盖后如果需要显示网格背面，将相应 MeshFilter 填入 doubleSidedMeshFilters。在载具附件配置编辑界面点击烘焙双面网格按钮，选择 Assets 内的输出目录；doubleSidedMeshes 是生成结果，不需要手工填写。只为必要的活动区域生成背面，避免整个载具的三角形数量翻倍。 配方使用独立复制的方片网格演示输入和输出引用，通过同一个烘焙实现直接指定目录，跳过交互式文件夹对话框。重复烘焙会更新已有生成网格并保留 GUID；源模型临时开启的 Read/Write 会在结束后恢复。此步骤验证网格数据与引用，没有验证最终渲染效果。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Light/AuthoringSamples/Square.obj", "${sourceMesh}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "references": [ { "property": "m_Mesh", "asset": "${sourceMesh}", "type": "UnityEngine.Mesh" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "doubleSidedMeshFilters": [ {} ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.doubleSidedMeshFilters.Array.data[0]", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.VehicleHatchMeshBaker/BakePrefab", "args": [ "${asset}", "", "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "_DoubleSided_" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/doubleSidedMeshes/Length" }, "expect": { "contains": "1" } } ]

manual/mod/vehicle-light-component.html.summary: VehicleLightAttachment 使用说明 中文 | English 下方 MCP 示例使用独立教学资产。${变量} 由共享配方提供；在仓库根目录运行以下命令可创建样例、逐组执行并重拍两种语言。调用经本机 Unity MCP 的相同路由执行。 python 本例配置一个圆形近光灯。VehicleLightAttachment 是序列化配置数据；挂载到 GameObject 的组件是 VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent。字段名保留 C# 原始标识符。 1. 创建组件并绑定对象 在载具 prefab 中创建灯光物体，添加 VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent。展开 manual/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.title: 02.7 祝昔的载具 Mod 开发总结 Vehicle Modding Notes by 祝昔 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.summary: 02.7 祝昔的载具 Mod 开发总结 Vehicle Modding Notes by 祝昔 作者：@情绪薫 Author: @情绪薫 PW 模组制作中可能遇到的问题 Problems you may run into when making Mods for PW 首先模型获取途径 Where to Get Models 第一个 Sketchfab - The best 3D viewer on the web，上面有着大量模型，包括付费以及免费模型。 First, Sketchfab - The best 3D viewer on the web. It hosts a large number of models, both paid and free. 第二个 游戏中的载具模型 (gamemodels3d.com)，上面有 WT、WOT、WOTB、AW 的大量模型，并且大部分 WT 模型都包含内构，需要付费注册账号来下载模型。 Second, 游戏中的载具模型 (gamemodels3d.com). It has a large number of models from WT, WOT, WOTB and AW, and most WT models include internal structure. You need a paid account to download the models. 第三个 CGTrader - 3D Models for VR / AR and CG projects，上面有着大量付费模型。 Third, CGTrader - 3D Models for VR / AR and CG projects. It has a large number of paid models. 第四个其他。 Fourth, other sources. 接下来分为制作模组中遇到的问题以及制作更好的模组遇到的问题两个方面。 The rest is divided into two parts: problems encountered while making a Mod and problems encountered while making a better Mod. 制作模组中遇到的问题 Problems Encountered While Making a Mod 模型原点的确定 Determining the model origin 无炮塔坦歼 Turretless tank destroyers 模组制作了内构但游戏里不显示 The Mod has internal structure but it does not show up in game 在编辑过程中突然看不到 hitbox The hitbox suddenly disappears while editing 坦克在车库中起飞翻转 The tank takes off and flips over in the garage 炮弹击中后产生的贴图过大 The decal produced when a shell hits is too large 模组在游戏内不显示 The Mod does not show up in game 制作更好的模组遇到的问题 Problems Encountered While Making a Better Mod 动画 Animation 实体履带 Solid tracks 不同方向炮塔不同俯仰角 Different elevation angles in different turret directions 如何给模组设置缩略图 How to set a thumbnail for a Mod 如何设置爆反装甲 How to set up reactive armor 模组查看装甲时部分装甲透明 Some armor is transparent when viewing armor in a Mod 去除内构模型颜色 Removing the colors from internal structure models 给模型起名字 Naming the model 多边形炮管变圆 Making a faceted gun barrel look round 多炮塔例子 A multi-turret example 配对节点和重力节点 Pairing nodes and gravity nodes 如何解决模组启动停止时的猛烈磕头 How to fix violent nose-diving when the Mod starts and stops 一、在制作模组中遇到的问题 Part 1: Problems Encountered While Making a Mod 1. 模型原点的确定 Determining the Model Origin 在 Blender 中，你需要对以下部件设置原点。 In Blender you need to set the origin for the following parts. 炮塔 (Turret)：设置炮塔原点以确保炮塔绕轴进行水平转动。 Turret: set the turret origin so that the turret rotates horizontally around its axis. （先点击左侧工具栏中的移动，然后勾选右上角的原点、父级，然后就可以将物体原点移动到你想要的地方，完成后记得取消勾选原点和父级。） (First click Move in the left toolbar, then tick Origin and Parent in the top right. You can then move the object origin wherever you want. Remember to untick Origin and Parent when you are done.) 炮盾 (Gun)：将设置炮盾原点以确保坦克炮管俯仰正常。 Gun mantlet (Gun): set the mantlet origin so that the tank's gun barrel elevates and depresses correctly. 炮管 (Dym)：设置炮管原点来确保炮弹发射位置正确。 Gun barrel (Dym): set the barrel origin so that shells are fired from the correct position. 轮子 (UpperWheel 以及 Wheel)：右键设置原点在质心体积来确保轮子绕轴旋转。 Wheels (UpperWheel and Wheel): right-click and set the origin to center of mass (volume) so that the wheels rotate around their axis. 2. 无炮塔坦歼 Turretless Tank Destroyers 对于无炮塔坦歼如猎虎，在 Blender 中按 Shift+A，创建一个空轴来作为其炮塔，按 G 来移动空轴原点。 For turretless tank destroyers such as the Jagdtiger, press shift+a in Blender to create an empty that acts as the turret, and press g to move the empty's origin. 3. 模组制作了内构但游戏里不显示 The Mod Has Internal Structure but It Does Not Show up in Game 查看是否勾选配置模块化信息。 Check whether Is Module Ready is ticked. 4. 在编辑过程中突然看不到 hitbox The Hitbox Suddenly Disappears While Editing 查看 hitbox 是否隐藏。 Check whether the hitbox is hidden. 5. 坦克在车库中起飞翻转 The Tank Takes off and Flips over in the Garage 查看是否设置坦克质量。 Check whether you have set the tank's mass. 6. 炮弹击中后产生的贴图过大 The Decal Produced When a Shell Hits Is Too Large 查看炮弹口径是否填写出错。 Check whether the shell caliber has been entered incorrectly. 7. 模组在游戏内不显示 The Mod Does Not Show up in Game 查看是否有音效未填。 Check whether any sound effect fields have been left empty. 二、如何制作更好的模组 Part 2: How to Make a Better Mod 1. 动画 Animation 举例某些坦克上有旋转的雷达。 For example, some tanks have a rotating radar. 如图在合适的位置创建一个空轴来保证雷达绕此轴旋转，然后将雷达放入空轴中，将空轴移动到炮塔下。 As shown in the pictures, create an empty at a suitable position so that the radar rotates around that axis, then put the radar inside the empty and move the empty under the turret. 接着在 Unity 中将物体拖入左侧栏中，选中该物体的雷达部件，右侧选择 Animation，Animation 制作教程可参照下面的视频。 Then in Unity, drag the object into the left panel, select the radar part of that object, and choose Animation on the right. For an animation tutorial, refer to the video below. https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zR4y1G7rt/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 制作完后需要将 Animator 勾选（没有则需要在下方 Add Component 选择 Animator）。 When you are done you need to tick Animator (if there is none, use Add Component at the bottom to add an Animator). 最后模型上好贴图并设置碰撞体积，放入 collision 文件夹中保存即可。 Finally, apply the textures to the model, set up the collision volumes, place them in the collision folder and save. 2. 实体履带 Solid Tracks 将履带块模型分离出来后，右键设置原点在质心（体积），接着右键吸附-选中项-游标，将模型角度调整如下，然后 Ctrl+A 应用旋转，保存即可。 After separating out the track link model, right-click and set the origin to center of mass (volume). Then right-click Snap - Selection to Cursor, adjust the model angle as shown below, press ctrl+a to apply the rotation, and save. 注意，当你需要设置左右两侧履带模型时，左履带模型需在上图基础上顺时针转动 180 度后再应用旋转。 Note: when you need to set up track models for both the left and right sides, the left track model has to be rotated 180 degrees clockwise from the state shown above before you apply the rotation. 3. 不同方向炮塔不同俯仰角 Different Elevation Angles in Different Turret Directions 大部分坦克在不同方向的俯仰角不同，可以在特殊的俯仰角位置中进行设置。 Most tanks have different gun elevation limits depending on the direction. You can configure this in the special elevation angle section. 4. 如何给模组设置缩略图 How to Set a Thumbnail for a Mod 将你的图片放入编辑器后，右侧设置选择 Sprite 和 Single，再点击下方的 Apply 即可。 After importing your image into the editor, choose Sprite and Single in the settings on the right, then click Apply at the bottom. 5. 如何设置爆反装甲 How to Set up Reactive Armor 将爆反在 HitBox 中设置为 reactive armor，同时在内构中将其设置为内部装甲（你也可建一个内部爆反的模型）。 Set the reactive armor to reactive armor in the HitBox, and set it as internal armor in the internal structure (you can also build a separate model for the internal reactive armor). 6. 模组查看装甲时部分装甲透明 Some Armor Is Transparent When Viewing Armor in a Mod 有时当你查看一些地方的装甲时，它不会是红绿黄三色之一，而是透明的，这代表着该处法线反了，你需要按 Tab 进入编辑模式后选中透明处装甲，按 Shift+N 来将法线调正。也可通过这个视频来学习如何修复法线。https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xr4y187Fc/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 Sometimes when you inspect the armor in a certain place it is not one of the three colors (red, green, yellow) but transparent. That means the normals there are flipped. Press tab to enter edit mode, select the transparent armor, and press shift+n to correct the normals. You can also watch this video to learn how to fix normals: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xr4y187Fc/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 7. 去除内构模型颜色 Removing the Colors from Internal Structure Models 有时当你查看内构时，有些内构模型仍然有贴图存在，这时你需要将内构模型拖入 Unity 左侧栏中，点击 Reset 来去除所有贴图，再对模型进行保存。 Sometimes when you view the internal structure, some internal models still have textures on them. In that case, drag the internal model into Unity's left panel, click Reset to remove all textures, then save the model. 8. 给模型起名字 Naming the Model 9. 多边形炮管变圆 Making a Faceted Gun Barrel Look Round 有时你所拿到模型它的炮管和其他一些部位是多边形的，你可以在 Blender 中点击模型，然后右键平滑着色来让它变圆。 Sometimes the model you get has a faceted gun barrel and other faceted parts. In Blender you can click the model and then right-click Shade Smooth to make it look round. 10. 多炮塔例子 A Multi-Turret Example 其中 SubTurret02 是炮塔顶部的机枪，我用空轴来作为它的 Dym。 SubTurret02 is the machine gun on top of the turret; I used an empty as its dym. 而 SubTurret01 是共轴机枪，我将三个空轴叠加来作为共轴机枪，并套在 Dym 下，这使得它将同主炮一同移动，而你不需要设置其他多余的数据（如炮塔俯仰角，转速）。 SubTurret01 is the coaxial machine gun. I stacked three empties to serve as the coaxial machine gun and nested them under Dym, which makes it move together with the main gun, so you do not have to set any extra data (such as turret elevation angles or traverse speed). 11. 配对节点和重力节点 Pairing Nodes and Gravity Nodes 重力节点意味着履带在该点会受到重力影响而自然下垂。 A gravity node means that the track will sag naturally at that point under the influence of gravity. 而配对节点则能够使得上下履带随负重轮一同上下运动。 A pairing node makes the upper and lower track move up and down together with the road wheels. 如下图使用。 Use them as shown below. 12. 如何解决模组启动停止时的猛烈磕头 How to Fix Violent Nose-Diving When the Mod Starts and Stops 一是将 Center of Gravity 摆放适中同时将其稍微下移（重心越高越不稳定），二是调整 WheelCollider 中右侧数据来调整摩擦。 First, place the center of gravity in a moderate position and move it slightly downwards (the higher the center of gravity, the less stable the vehicle is). Second, adjust the values on the right side of the wheelcollider to tune friction. 详情请见此 https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43147385/article/details/124266796 See this article for details: https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43147385/article/details/124266796

LTD. 所有。 This project is only for debugging, you should not re-ship this project. Copyright belongs to WINDYVERSE PTE. LTD. Usage 使用方法 How to quit? 如何退出试车场 Hold Alt key and click play button 按住 Alt 键，点击播放按钮 Switch module/hp mode 切换模块/血条模式 We use module mode as default. An oversized thumbnail causes a serious memory burden. 推荐设置为 640 x 360，这是游戏的标准缩略图尺寸。过大的缩略图会导致严重的内存负担。 Set the Vehicle to Render 设置渲染载具 Drag the vehicle prefab into the list. 将载具预制体拖入列表。 The rendered image can be found at Others\Renderering\Common\KV-1.png, in the folder next to Assets. 渲染后的图片位于 Assets 同级目录下的 Others\Renderering\Common\KV-1.png。 Import the image into Unity, then drag it into this field. 将图片导入 Unity，然后拖入此字段。

manual/mod/vfx-mod.html.title: 07. VFX Mod 特效模组 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/vfx-mod.html.summary: 07. VFX Mod 特效模组 Identifier 资源标识 通过资源标识创建特效包的选项，以便选择并切换不同的特效包。 The resource identifier creates the entry for a VFX package, so that different VFX packages can be selected and switched between. 旧版“马哥特效包”的共享 Identifier 资产已无法恢复。若仅制作自己的特效包，请在 Project 窗口中选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > P Pool - 对象池 > Pool Resource Identifier - 对象池标识 新建 Identifier，并将其关联到下方的 Pool Resource。Identifier 的 GUID 会自动生成。 The shared Identifier asset of the old “马哥特效包” VFX package can no longer be recovered. If you are only building your own VFX package, create a new Identifier from the Project window with Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > P Pool - 对象池 > Pool Resource Identifier - 对象池标识, then link it to the Pool Resource below. The GUID of the Identifier is generated automatically. 若必须向旧特效包追加资源，需从原特效包作者处获取同一个 Identifier 资产；新建资产的 GUID 不同，不能作为兼容替代。 If you really need to add resources to an old VFX package, you must obtain the very same Identifier asset from the author of that package. A newly created asset has a different GUID and cannot serve as a compatible replacement. Pool Resource 特效资源 创建 Pool Resource，并关联 Identifier。 Create a Pool Resource and link the Identifier to it. 添加 Spawn Reses Add Spawn Reses. 特效名称：特效的键值，可自定义，然后在 Bullet VFX 中选择该自定义特效键值进行关联。 VFX name: the key of the effect. You may name it freely, then select this custom key in Bullet VFX to link the two. 特效物体：特效的预制体。 VFX object: the prefab of the effect. 预加载实例数量：在加载场景时，预先加载一批特效进内存，以减少游戏时的卡顿。但填写过大的数量会导致加载时间增加。填写 -1 则表示运行时根据需求再创建。 Preload instance count: loads a batch of effects into memory while the scene is loading, which reduces stutter during play. Entering too large a number increases the loading time. Enter -1 to create instances on demand at runtime instead. 生命时长：特效播放的时长，时间到之后会被回收以便下次使用。请不要填写 0，0 是为喷火、激光等特殊特效所准备的。 Lifetime: how long the effect plays. When the time is up, the effect is recycled so it can be used again. Do not enter 0 — 0 is reserved for special effects such as flamethrowers and lasers. 特效对象池的物体，请挂载 PoolItemComponent。若此物体是炮弹的 Weapon Projectile，请将其拖尾特效挂到指定位置。 Attach PoolItemComponent to the objects in the VFX pool. If the object is the Weapon Projectile of a shell, attach its trail effect at the designated position. Using the VFX 特效的使用 在重载中，选择你的特效。如果不使用重载的选项，请务必将你的特效的模组包放入你的载具依赖的 guid 中。 Select your effect in the override settings. If you do not use the override option, make sure the guid of your VFX mod package is added to the dependency guids of your vehicle. Build 打包 将 Pool Resource 放入 BuildPipline。 Put the Pool Resource into the BuildPipline.

manual/mod/voice-pack-practice.html.title: 26.3. VoicePack As Practice 语音包实战 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/voice-pack-practice.html.summary: 26.3. VoicePack As Practice 语音包实战 As an example, this chapter will introduce the events in Fmod and configs for the game. 以语音包为例，本章将讲解 Fmod 中的事件以及游戏的音频配置。 1. Import Assets 导入资源 Create a subfolder in the crew folder, and drag your voice assets into this folder. 在 crew 文件夹下创建一个子文件夹，然后将音频文件拖入该文件夹。 2. Create Events 创建事件 Create a subfolder in crew/ground. Select a set of existing voice events. Press Ctrl + D to duplicate it and drag it into the newly created subfolder. Change the suffix from cn to whatever you want. 在 crew/ground 下创建一个子文件夹，选中一组现有的语音事件，按 Ctrl + D 复制并将其拖入刚刚创建的子文件夹。将事件后缀从 cn 更改为你想要的标识。例如，如图中所示，将 cn 改为 jp。 Select your event. Delete the original sounds from the playlist and add your sounds into the playlist one by one. 选中该事件，将 Playlist 中的原有音频删除，然后逐一将你的音频拖入其中。 3. Check Mixer 检查 Mixer Press Ctrl + 2 to enter the Mixer window. Be sure the newly created events are under the dialogs group. 按 Ctrl + 2 进入 Mixer 窗口，确保新创建的事件位于 dialogs 组中。 4. Create Sound Bank 创建 SoundBank Create a new bank under Banks. 在 Banks 中创建一个新的 Bank。 Then build all platforms. It will generate bank files at PanzerWar-Mods\PanzerWar-FMod-UGC-Project\Build. 然后，打包所有平台。Bank 文件将在 PanzerWar-Mods\PanzerWar-FMod-UGC-Project\Build 目录下生成。 Then the work in Fmod Studio is finished. Let's go back to the Unity project. 至此，Fmod Studio 中的工作已完成。让我们回到 Unity 工程。 5. Create Config 创建配置 Use the following tool to create configs faster. 使用以下工具快速创建配置。 5.1 Create Crew Voice Config 创建成员语音配置 Select the events that you created in Fmod in the previous step. 将上一步在 Fmod 中创建的事件名称填入对应类型。 5.2 Create Bank BuildPipline 创建 Bank 打包配置 Create the SoundBankBuildPiplineData Build file. 创建音效打包文件（SoundBankBuildPiplineData）。 Pick the folder that banks are built. 选择 Bank 文件所在的文件夹。 Pick .bank extension files. 选择 .bank 扩展名的文件。 In the configs array, sound bank configs are generated automatically. 在配置数组中，SoundBank Config 会自动生成。 6. Build Config 打包配置 Then, you can build like other Mods. 然后，即可像其他模组一样进行打包。

"${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleTextData.asset", "gun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedGun.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 本教程用 ZoomProfileData 资产为载具设置双目与瞄准镜的缩放倍率范围。所有字段名保持源代码中的原始拼写。 1. 创建 ZoomProfileData 资产 在 Project 窗口选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Base - 载具配置 > Zoom - 倍率，创建 ZoomProfileData 资产。展开 倍率名称（zoomName），把默认名称填为 Tutorial Zoom。 本例使用独立教学资产，不修改现有载具配置。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { manual/workshop/glb-model-import-specs.h.title: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/glb-model-import-specs.h.summary: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 The tutorial process uses Blender modeling software, and the steps can be referred to for other modeling software as well. Blender can be downloaded for free on Steam. 本教程流程基于 Blender 建模软件，其他建模软件亦可参考本教程中的规范。Blender 可在 Steam 上免费下载。 Prepare Visual Model 准备外观模型 If using Blender, please refer to the following documentation. For the PBR workflow, follow the PBR rules outlined in the documentation to create the following textures: 1. Base Color, 2. Metallic and Roughness, 3. Baked Ambient Occlusion, and 4. Normal Map. Other textures mentioned in the documentation are not required. You can use Substance Painter to create the necessary textures. If not following the PBR workflow, you need to create 1. Base Color (mandatory) and 2. Normal Map (optional). However, the model will not achieve realistic physical reflections. 若使用 Blender，请参考以下文档。 若采用 PBR 流程，需遵循文档中的 PBR 规则，制作以下贴图：1. 基础色，2. 金属度与粗糙度，3. 烘焙的环境光遮蔽，以及 4. 法线贴图。文档中提及的其他贴图无需制作。可使用 Substance Painter 制作相应贴图。 若未采用 PBR 流程，则需制作 1. 基础色（必选）和 2. 法线贴图（可选）。但模型将无法呈现真实的物理反光效果。 glTF 2.0 - Blender 4.3 Manual （中文用户点击此链接打开文档：https://docs.blender.org/manual/zh-hans/4.3/addons/import_export/scene_gltf2.html） Preview the effect of the completed model in Blender. 在 Blender 中预览制作完成后的模型效果。 Additionally, you need to use LOD tools to create corresponding low-polygon models for displaying objects at a distance, reducing rendering performance pressure. You can choose to use the InstaLOD Blender plugin to automatically create LODs: 此外，需使用 LOD 工具制作对应的低多边形模型，用于物体在远处的显示，以降低渲染性能压力。可选择使用 InstaLOD Blender 插件自动创建 LOD： Follow the InstaLOD for Blender official installation guide to sign in to License Management, then download the latest plugin and the InstaLOD Pipeline from Your Files. 请按照 InstaLOD for Blender 官方安装文档登录 License Management，并从 Your Files 下载最新插件和 InstaLOD Pipeline。 Or use InstaLOD Studio: follow the InstaLOD Studio official installation guide to download and install the standalone version. 或者按照 InstaLOD Studio 官方安装文档下载并安装独立版。 If you do not use InstaLOD, you can also create low-polygon LODs manually with Blender's built-in Decimate Modifier. 不使用 InstaLOD 时，也可使用 Blender 内置的 Decimate Modifier手动制作低面数 LOD。 Child-Parent 父子关系 Rule 放置规则 Create four empty objects (Shift + A and select Empty - Plain Axes) and name them Visual, Collider, HitBox, and Module respectively. Note that the size and spelling must be exactly the same. Visual is used for placing the appearance model and LOD, Collider is used for placing non-concave collision models, HitBox is used for placing external armor, and Module is used for placing internal armor. 创建四个空物体（Shift + A 选择 Empty - Plain Axes），并分别命名为 Visual、Collider、HitBox 与 Module。注意，大小与拼写必须保持完全一致。Visual 用于放置外观模型与 LOD，Collider 用于放置非凹碰撞模型，HitBox 用于放置外部装甲，Module 用于放置内部装甲。 Completed State 制作完成后状态 After completing the various models, place them according to the rules in section 2.1. The specifications for creating damage models and internal structure models will be introduced in sections 3 and 4. (If this module is an object that can be hit by shells, these two models must be created.) The Collider collision model only needs to be created when making the vehicle hull model. 在制作完成各类模型后，按照 2.1 节的规则放置各类模型。 伤害模型与内构模型的制作规范将在第 3、4 节中介绍。（若此模块是可被炮弹击中的物体，则必须制作这两个模型。） 仅在制作车体模型时，才需要创建 Collider 碰撞模型。 LOD 特殊处理 Make the LOD models child objects of the unoptimized model and name them OriginalObjectName_LODNumber (starting from 1, up to a maximum of 3 LOD levels). **The name of the unoptimized original model must end with LOD0. ** 将 LOD 模型设为未优化模型的子物体，并命名为 原始物体名称_LOD序号（序号从 1 开始，至多可制作 3 层 LOD）。未优化的原始模型名称必须以 LOD0 结尾。 LOD 模型 HitBox 外部装甲 Reduced-polygon versions of the visual model. Models with different armor thicknesses need to be separated and then set their armor type and armor thickness according to the naming conventions in section 5. 外观模型的减面版本。不同装甲厚度的模型需分离，然后根据第 5 节的命名规范设置其装甲类型与装甲厚度。 Internal Module 内构模型 Lower-polygon internal module models are used for post-penetration shell damage. Then, set their type, armor thickness, and health according to the naming conventions in section 5. 较低面数的内部模块模型，用于炮弹穿透后的伤害。随后，根据第 5 节的命名规范设置其类型、装甲厚度与血量。 Collider 碰撞模型 A collision model only needs to be created for the vehicle hull model. 仅当制作车体模型时，才需要创建碰撞模型。 Naming 命名规范 2.12 HitBox Naming 伤害模型命名规范 Export 导出 Select the model you want to export, then click on glTF 2.0, choose the .glb format, check Selected Objects, and click Export. 选中要导出的模型，点击 glTF 2.0，选择 .glb 格式，勾选 Selected Objects，然后点击 Export。 Using Model 使用模型 Use Model Importer 使用模型导入工具 Windows Platform 电脑平台 Android Platform 安卓平台 Click on the glb format file and select Panzer War: Definitive Edition as the opening application. Enter the Tank Workshop, choose Model Import, and enter your glb file name (including the file extension). 点击 glb 格式文件，选择 装甲纷争：决定版 作为打开方式。进入坦克工坊，选择 模型导入，输入 glb 文件名（包含后缀）。

manual/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.title: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.summary: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 Custom Reload Type 自定义装填类型 Simple 简单 Traditional single-shot shells only require setting the reload time. 传统的单发炮弹，仅需设置装填时间。 Advanced 高级 For multi-shot magazine guns, you need to set the small reload time, the large reload time, and the magazine size. 多发弹夹炮需要设置小装填时间、大装填时间以及弹夹容量。 If the magazine size is too large, you can hide the icon to avoid a cluttered UI. 如果弹夹容量过大，可以隐藏图标，以避免 UI 过于拥挤。 Drum 弹鼓 Invented by the Italians, the drum mechanism is an optimized type of magazine gun that allows you to fire while loading backup rounds. You need to set the reload time for each backup round and the minimum firing interval of the drum. 由意大利人发明的弹鼓机制，是弹夹炮的一种优化类型，允许在装载备弹的同时开火。需要设置每发备弹的装填时间以及弹鼓的最小射击间隔。 Import Default Bullet 导入现有炮弹 You can modify the specific parameters of the default shells by importing the default shells. 你可以通过导入默认炮弹来修改其具体参数。 If you wish to fully customize your shells, you can also directly add different types of shells using the add button above. 如果你希望完全自定义炮弹，也可以直接通过上方的添加按钮，添加不同类型的炮弹。 The shell data will display the basic parameters of the shell, along with some specialized parameters in modular mode. 炮弹数据将显示炮弹的基本参数，以及模块模式下的部分专用参数。 In the debugging information of the shell, you can see the calculated data. If you modify the parameters of the shell, you need to click the recalculate button. 在炮弹的调试信息中，你可以查看计算后的数据。若修改了炮弹参数，需点击重新计算按钮。 Demarre Formula 德马尔公式 In our game, the penetration mechanics are based on the De Marre formula, which is used to estimate the penetration of a shell against armor. Here is an explanation of the formula and its parameters. 在我们的游戏中，穿甲机制基于德马尔公式，用于估算炮弹对装甲的穿透能力。以下是公式及其参数的解释。 \(\text{Penetration 穿深} = \left( \frac{m \cdot v_{\text{rel}}^2}{d^3 \cdot D_{\text{term}}} \right)^{\frac{1}{C_{\text{armor}}}} \cdot d \cdot K_{\text{nap}} \cdot 100\) \(m\) is the shell mass (kg) 是炮弹的质量（千克）； \(v_{\text{rel}}\) is the shell velocity component in the direction of the plate, calculated as: 是炮弹沿装甲板方向的速度分量，计算如下： \(v_{\text{rel}} = v_d \cdot \cos(\theta \cdot 0.85 \cdot C_{\text{angle}})\) \(v_d = v_0 \left( 1 - \frac{\lambda d}{v_0} \right)\) where \(C_{\text{angle}}\) is the penetration vs angle coefficient, \(\lambda\) is the drag, and \(v_0\) is the initial velocity; 其中 \(C_{\text{angle}}\) 是斜穿系数，\(\lambda\) 是阻力，\(v_0\) 是炮弹初速度； \(d\) is the shell diameter (m) 是炮弹直径（单位：米）； \(D_{\text{term}}\) is the De Marre term, calculated as: 是德马尔项，计算如下： \(D_{\text{term}} = \left( D_{\text{const}} \right)^2 \cdot d^{-0.1}\) where \(D_{\text{const}}\) is the De Marre constant; 其中 \(D_{\text{const}}\) 是德马尔常数； \(C_{\text{armor}}\) is the armor material coefficient 是装甲材料系数； \(K_{\text{nap}}\) is the adjustment factor based on the TNT ratio, calculated as follows: 是基于 TNT 比例的调整系数，计算如下： $ K_{\text{nap}} = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 0.65 \ 1 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 0.65 \right) \cdot (0.93 - 1)}{1.6 - 0.65} & \text{if } 0.65 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 1.6 \ 0.93 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 1.6 \right) \cdot (0.9 - 0.93)}{2 - 1.6} & \text{if } 1.6 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 2 \ 0.9 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 2 \right) \cdot (0.85 - 0.9)}{3 - 2} & \text{if } 2 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 3 \ 0.85 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 3 \right) \cdot (0.75 - 0.85)}{4 - 3} & \text{if } 3 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 4 \ 0.75 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} \geq 4 \end{cases} $ This formula combines all the terms to calculate the penetration of the shell against armor, taking into account the mass, velocity, diameter, material properties, impact angle, and explosive charge of the shell. 该公式结合所有参数来计算炮弹对装甲的穿透力，考虑了炮弹的质量、速度、直径、材料特性、入射角度和装药量。

manual/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.title: 1. Poly Edit 建模工具 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.summary: 1. Poly Edit 建模工具 Use Editable Poly 使用可编辑多边形 In the Item tab, search for Editable, then install it onto the vehicle. Click the Edit Polygons button to enter edit mode. 在 Item 标签页中搜索 Editable，然后将其安装到载具上。点击 Edit Polygons 按钮，即可进入编辑模式。 Basic Options 基础选项 Face 面 In the right-side inspector window, select the Face, choose the faces on the model, and then click Move. Drag the arrow to edit the position of the face. Similarly, you can rotate the face orientation and use the Scale tool to modify the size of the face. 在右侧检查器窗口中选择面工具，选中模型上的面，然后点击 Move。拖动箭头即可编辑面的位置。同理，可以旋转面的朝向，并使用 Scale 工具修改面的大小。 Edge 边 Vertex 顶点 Operations 操作 Extrude 挤出功能 One of the most commonly used operations is used to extend a face. Select any face, then click the Extrude button. The face will move in its normal direction and extend out multiple new faces (as shown in the yellow area in the second image). 最常用的操作之一，用于扩展面。选中任意一个面，然后点击 Extrude 按钮，面会沿其法线方向移动，并扩展出多个新的面（如第二张图中的黄色区域所示）。 Bevel 倒角功能 Bevel is used to create chamfers on the edges or vertices of a model. In the image below, the red marked area shows the generated bevel. Bevel 用于在模型的边缘或顶点处创建倒角。下图中红色标记区域即为生成的倒角。 This document is still under construction, please check back later. This feature is currently in development. Future support will include: Importing obj files Models as external armor models Models as internal structures The full modeling tool functionality will be released in a future update. 本文档仍在建设中，请稍后查看。此功能目前仍处于开发阶段。 后续将支持： 导入 obj 文件 模型作为 HitBox 模型作为内部结构 完整的建模工具功能将在后续更新中发布。

Track Tutorial 履带编辑器 Dedicated Equipment 专用配件 You can find procedural track at the start. 你可以在列表开头找到程序化履带。 Attention 注意事项 Collision Setup 设置碰撞 Configure objects with collision in their slots to ensure the vehicle can move properly. Different types of colliders can affect the vehicle's physics in various ways. 在其插槽中配置带有碰撞的物体，以确保载具能够正常移动。不同类型的碰撞体会以不同方式影响载具的物理效果。 Pick Editable Poly 选择可编辑多边形 Enable its collider 启用其碰撞 Adjust center of gravity 调整重心 When creating your custom tank, adjusting the center of gravity is an important step to ensure your tank handles well. A higher center of gravity can cause the tank to tip over easily when turning or driving on uneven terrain, making it hard to control. By lowering the center of gravity or positioning it correctly, you can make your tank more stable and easier to handle, even in tough conditions. Make sure to experiment with different settings to find the perfect balance for your design! 在创建自定义坦克时，调整重心是确保坦克操控良好的关键步骤。重心过高会导致坦克在转弯或行驶于不平坦地形时容易倾翻，难以控制。通过降低重心或正确定位重心，可以使坦克更加稳定且易于操控，即使在复杂环境中也能轻松驾驭。请尝试不同的设置，以找到适合你设计的最佳平衡！
